programme.title: 万凰之王 #22 [粤]
programme.desc: 沅宛向赶至佛堂的道光哭诉爱儿已无气息，但最后终获救回；道光深信二阿哥化险为夷是上天被沅宛善心感动。伊兰派人打听沅宛的举动，并请锷泰加速调查父亲惨死内情；道光往替太后挑选鹿茸时，发现静贵人在打扫忏悔。道光借上天赐予两位阿哥为由，打算大赦天下，并点名特赦静贵人，使伊兰与沅宛同感不安。道光于大殿表示要追封颐龄，并安排锷泰加入军机处填补空缺，另外委派庆亲王担任禁烟大使严打鸦片，誓要找出朝中勾结地下鸦片商的官员。四个月后，大阿哥于「抓周」的仪式后无故失踪，伊兰惊见爱儿帽子在池内……。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #15 [粤]
programme.desc: 国强收到俊朗的「手指」后，接到戴波的电话提醒缴交赎金以保儿子的安全，但国强却故意隐瞒。嘉嘉使计让戴波无法追截，在酒店与波捉迷藏。展龙往找母亲了解与仕灿的关系时，发现惊天大秘密，仕灿竟是「杀父仇人」。贾瑜发现「比托尼亚星光」不翼而飞，并收到早安的道歉短讯后不禁失落。在追截嘉嘉的过程中，少男阳奉阴违放走嘉嘉，但最终仍被戴波发现并打晕。早安借魔术表演当众向贾瑜求婚，令瑜感动；展龙现身质问她是否考虑清楚接受早安，眼看贾瑜直言不会后悔，展龙失望只好祝福她。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #16 [粤]
programme.desc: 可人被早安骗情独自在天台沉思，早安出现并道出求婚只为了取得贾瑜的信任，以夺回财政大权。少男与嘉嘉把戴波带到厨房，却惊见俊朗不在，戴波遂以嘉嘉的安危要胁少男在限期内交出俊朗。早安约见唐晶，意图向她打听展龙的真正身分，并设偷听器监听展龙与唐晶的对话。展龙无意中发现姚丹一直监听启富的对话，她直认不讳更道出展龙的警察的身分。戴波成功把俊朗掳走，却遇上喝至半醉的Cooper阻拦，Cooper被波推落楼梯重伤；俊朗向护士长郑美华求助，两人成功避开戴波的追截。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #22 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁与超等以为红带众女看舞男跳艳舞，原来只是到楼上铺光顾买皮草，岂料发生火警，各人误以为众女被困紧张万分，几乎要冒险冲入火场，幸最后有惊无险，各人更冰释前嫌，唯独仁与珍碍于面子不肯相让。众友好为让二人和好，特意安排电台节目，惜因途经隧道而错失良机。凤凰楼重开，请来知名食家试食招牌名菜凤舞九宵，却苦于未能解破诗中秘方，被指出风味与传说有异，幸仁带同秘制酱汁及时出现。仁为挽回婚姻，努力向珍道歉求情。珍却提出要换转身份，让仁负责处理家中大小事务，亲身感受当家庭煮「夫」的感受。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 千禧年代，仁与珍的女儿戴思嘉因父母早丧，故养成独立自我，热爱自由不喜束缚的性格，对爱情抱合则来不合则去的态度。她在婚纱店内巧遇正拍摄婚纱照的方家安与林向欣时，更讥笑只有呆子才会想结婚。嘉揭穿男友Dicky见异思迁，愤而分手，复向摰友萧玉贞抱怨没有男友陪度除夕，不料嘉与Dicky在酒吧内碰面，嘉为报复借故生事，幸得安出面调解，可惜好心没好报，安的新娘欣与摄影师竟一见钟情，婚礼因悔婚而告吹。安解闷到酒吧买醉，却遇上欣，嘉替安出一口乌气，二人更共度良宵。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #88 [粤]
programme.desc: 闫器等在会议室和陈总倾谈过亿元的合作项目时， Herman不慎跌出一包香烟；陈总瞥见后眉头一皱。丽薇急忙告知陈总金波集团已全面禁烟，陈总才感满意。众人参观影楼时，陈总突然被自动洒水器淋湿，更发现是因有人随意丢弃烟头而起，陈总拂袖而去。家升查问编采部，国仁突然向众人道歉，指烟头属于他；殷赏估计他是为人顶包而感气结。殷赏要励军等人向国仁打探内情，可惜众男无从入手。冰冰神秘地往找家升和殷赏，承认是他请国仁顶包，要求两人保守她吸烟的秘密。家升不明所以，殷赏道出排版会议的经过……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #89 [粤]
programme.desc: 德在「好玩吧」不停招呼客人时突然发现一脸严肃的大，原来德曾向大借钱却迟迟未有还款。德宣传「好玩吧」有同行女伴买一送一的优惠，仁与众《潮》人支持「好玩吧」的Lady's night，升为鼓励士气决定请客。德向熟客追讨累积的数千元费用时，两人拉扯间德失去平衡跌下撞破额头。升见状即上前建议报警处理，德却突然站起来，道出他愿意不追究的条件……赏为德向大借钱，转头却发现德把钱还给大，遂质问大和德间的秘密，赏错愕。翌日，德竟把收回的酒帐还予赏，看到德终于学会独立，赏感动……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #90 [粤]
programme.desc: 国仁和殷赏拜祭包老师，国仁忆起亡父对自己的期望，下决心藉殷赏生日向她表白；两人访问时国仁看到殷赏对被访者的手链情有独钟，心生一计。国仁找来尧坚为他选购手链，尧坚眼见国仁预算有限，主动为他以信用卡结帐，国仁分期归还，尧坚并代他写好心意卡。汝大的旧同学为答谢他帮忙，送赠未发售的高容量储存装置，汝大当小礼物转送殷赏，岂料她错把国仁送的手链，误当是汝大所指的小礼物。国仁眼见殷赏误会，对自己没写下款感后悔。尧坚认为国仁应该把真相告诉殷赏，但国仁则希望借此测试殷赏对汝大的心意……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #22 [粤]
programme.desc: 沅宛向赶至佛堂的道光哭诉爱儿已无气息，但最后终获救回；道光深信二阿哥化险为夷是上天被沅宛善心感动。伊兰派人打听沅宛的举动，并请锷泰加速调查父亲惨死内情；道光往替太后挑选鹿茸时，发现静贵人在打扫忏悔。道光借上天赐予两位阿哥为由，打算大赦天下，并点名特赦静贵人，使伊兰与沅宛同感不安。道光于大殿表示要追封颐龄，并安排锷泰加入军机处填补空缺，另外委派庆亲王担任禁烟大使严打鸦片，誓要找出朝中勾结地下鸦片商的官员。四个月后，大阿哥于「抓周」的仪式后无故失踪，伊兰惊见爱儿帽子在池内……。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #15 [粤]
programme.desc: 国强收到俊朗的「手指」后，接到戴波的电话提醒缴交赎金以保儿子的安全，但国强却故意隐瞒。嘉嘉使计让戴波无法追截，在酒店与波捉迷藏。展龙往找母亲了解与仕灿的关系时，发现惊天大秘密，仕灿竟是「杀父仇人」。贾瑜发现「比托尼亚星光」不翼而飞，并收到早安的道歉短讯后不禁失落。在追截嘉嘉的过程中，少男阳奉阴违放走嘉嘉，但最终仍被戴波发现并打晕。早安借魔术表演当众向贾瑜求婚，令瑜感动；展龙现身质问她是否考虑清楚接受早安，眼看贾瑜直言不会后悔，展龙失望只好祝福她。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #16 [粤]
programme.desc: 可人被早安骗情独自在天台沉思，早安出现并道出求婚只为了取得贾瑜的信任，以夺回财政大权。少男与嘉嘉把戴波带到厨房，却惊见俊朗不在，戴波遂以嘉嘉的安危要胁少男在限期内交出俊朗。早安约见唐晶，意图向她打听展龙的真正身分，并设偷听器监听展龙与唐晶的对话。展龙无意中发现姚丹一直监听启富的对话，她直认不讳更道出展龙的警察的身分。戴波成功把俊朗掳走，却遇上喝至半醉的Cooper阻拦，Cooper被波推落楼梯重伤；俊朗向护士长郑美华求助，两人成功避开戴波的追截。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #22 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁与超等以为红带众女看舞男跳艳舞，原来只是到楼上铺光顾买皮草，岂料发生火警，各人误以为众女被困紧张万分，几乎要冒险冲入火场，幸最后有惊无险，各人更冰释前嫌，唯独仁与珍碍于面子不肯相让。众友好为让二人和好，特意安排电台节目，惜因途经隧道而错失良机。凤凰楼重开，请来知名食家试食招牌名菜凤舞九宵，却苦于未能解破诗中秘方，被指出风味与传说有异，幸仁带同秘制酱汁及时出现。仁为挽回婚姻，努力向珍道歉求情。珍却提出要换转身份，让仁负责处理家中大小事务，亲身感受当家庭煮「夫」的感受。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 千禧年代，仁与珍的女儿戴思嘉因父母早丧，故养成独立自我，热爱自由不喜束缚的性格，对爱情抱合则来不合则去的态度。她在婚纱店内巧遇正拍摄婚纱照的方家安与林向欣时，更讥笑只有呆子才会想结婚。嘉揭穿男友Dicky见异思迁，愤而分手，复向摰友萧玉贞抱怨没有男友陪度除夕，不料嘉与Dicky在酒吧内碰面，嘉为报复借故生事，幸得安出面调解，可惜好心没好报，安的新娘欣与摄影师竟一见钟情，婚礼因悔婚而告吹。安解闷到酒吧买醉，却遇上欣，嘉替安出一口乌气，二人更共度良宵。

programme.desc: 可人被早安骗情独自在天台沉思，早安出现并道出求婚只为了取得贾瑜的信任，以夺回财政大权。少男与嘉嘉把戴波带到厨房，却惊见俊朗不在，戴波遂以嘉嘉的安危要胁少男在限期内交出俊朗。早安约见唐晶，意图向她打听展龙的真正身分，并设偷听器监听展龙与唐晶的对话。展龙无意中发现姚丹一直监听启富的对话，她直认不讳更道出展龙的警察的身分。戴波成功把俊朗掳走，却遇上喝至半醉的Cooper阻拦，Cooper被波推落楼梯重伤；俊朗向护士长郑美华求助，两人成功避开戴波的追截。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #22 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁与超等以为红带众女看舞男跳艳舞，原来只是到楼上铺光顾买皮草，岂料发生火警，各人误以为众女被困紧张万分，几乎要冒险冲入火场，幸最后有惊无险，各人更冰释前嫌，唯独仁与珍碍于面子不肯相让。众友好为让二人和好，特意安排电台节目，惜因途经隧道而错失良机。凤凰楼重开，请来知名食家试食招牌名菜凤舞九宵，却苦于未能解破诗中秘方，被指出风味与传说有异，幸仁带同秘制酱汁及时出现。仁为挽回婚姻，努力向珍道歉求情。珍却提出要换转身份，让仁负责处理家中大小事务，亲身感受当家庭煮「夫」的感受。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 千禧年代，仁与珍的女儿戴思嘉因父母早丧，故养成独立自我，热爱自由不喜束缚的性格，对爱情抱合则来不合则去的态度。她在婚纱店内巧遇正拍摄婚纱照的方家安与林向欣时，更讥笑只有呆子才会想结婚。嘉揭穿男友Dicky见异思迁，愤而分手，复向摰友萧玉贞抱怨没有男友陪度除夕，不料嘉与Dicky在酒吧内碰面，嘉为报复借故生事，幸得安出面调解，可惜好心没好报，安的新娘欣与摄影师竟一见钟情，婚礼因悔婚而告吹。安解闷到酒吧买醉，却遇上欣，嘉替安出一口乌气，二人更共度良宵。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #89 [粤]
programme.desc: 德在「好玩吧」不停招呼客人时突然发现一脸严肃的大，原来德曾向大借钱却迟迟未有还款。德宣传「好玩吧」有同行女伴买一送一的优惠，仁与众《潮》人支持「好玩吧」的Lady's night，升为鼓励士气决定请客。德向熟客追讨累积的数千元费用时，两人拉扯间德失去平衡跌下撞破额头。升见状即上前建议报警处理，德却突然站起来，道出他愿意不追究的条件……赏为德向大借钱，转头却发现德把钱还给大，遂质问大和德间的秘密，赏错愕。翌日，德竟把收回的酒帐还予赏，看到德终于学会独立，赏感动……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #90 [粤]
programme.desc: 国仁和殷赏拜祭包老师，国仁忆起亡父对自己的期望，下决心藉殷赏生日向她表白；两人访问时国仁看到殷赏对被访者的手链情有独钟，心生一计。国仁找来尧坚为他选购手链，尧坚眼见国仁预算有限，主动为他以信用卡结帐，国仁分期归还，尧坚并代他写好心意卡。汝大的旧同学为答谢他帮忙，送赠未发售的高容量储存装置，汝大当小礼物转送殷赏，岂料她错把国仁送的手链，误当是汝大所指的小礼物。国仁眼见殷赏误会，对自己没写下款感后悔。尧坚认为国仁应该把真相告诉殷赏，但国仁则希望借此测试殷赏对汝大的心意……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #22 [粤]
programme.desc: 沅宛向赶至佛堂的道光哭诉爱儿已无气息，但最后终获救回；道光深信二阿哥化险为夷是上天被沅宛善心感动。伊兰派人打听沅宛的举动，并请锷泰加速调查父亲惨死内情；道光往替太后挑选鹿茸时，发现静贵人在打扫忏悔。道光借上天赐予两位阿哥为由，打算大赦天下，并点名特赦静贵人，使伊兰与沅宛同感不安。道光于大殿表示要追封颐龄，并安排锷泰加入军机处填补空缺，另外委派庆亲王担任禁烟大使严打鸦片，誓要找出朝中勾结地下鸦片商的官员。四个月后，大阿哥于「抓周」的仪式后无故失踪，伊兰惊见爱儿帽子在池内……。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #15 [粤]
programme.desc: 国强收到俊朗的「手指」后，接到戴波的电话提醒缴交赎金以保儿子的安全，但国强却故意隐瞒。嘉嘉使计让戴波无法追截，在酒店与波捉迷藏。展龙往找母亲了解与仕灿的关系时，发现惊天大秘密，仕灿竟是「杀父仇人」。贾瑜发现「比托尼亚星光」不翼而飞，并收到早安的道歉短讯后不禁失落。在追截嘉嘉的过程中，少男阳奉阴违放走嘉嘉，但最终仍被戴波发现并打晕。早安借魔术表演当众向贾瑜求婚，令瑜感动；展龙现身质问她是否考虑清楚接受早安，眼看贾瑜直言不会后悔，展龙失望只好祝福她。

programme.title: 万凰之王 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰认定沅宛妒忌而捉去大阿哥，但沅宛发誓不是自己所为；沅宛往找静贵人问责，但她矢口否认。太医证实道光患有偏头痛，建议以微量鸦片止痛，道光大惊并坚拒服用。舒明阿接到有关鸦片的密报后打算偷龙转凤，谁不知东窗事发。舒明阿招认一切，唯独拒绝承认劫走颐龄一事，道光一气之下决定将其处斩。穆章阿向太后报告借刀除去舒明阿之计成功，加上近日庆亲王因严打鸦片而激起民愤，相信成就大事之期指日可待；道光难抵头痛，打算试服少量鸦片，却甚感内疚，遂到佛堂祈求上天指引，未料因此而揭发沅宛与绵忻的奸情……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #17 [粤]
programme.desc: 展龙向贾瑜说出早安欲毒害她，安自辩开脱，贾瑜对早安深信不疑；戴波毒打少男与嘉嘉，幸得仕灿现身将两人救走。美华竟是生俊朗的代母，向国强了解俊朗多年来的生活，后悔当年收下二百万放弃儿子的抚养权。小茵出现早产症状，家燕与贾瑜遂合力扶她到医疗室，谁知电梯中途失灵，小茵被迫在内产子。贾瑜决定试探未婚夫，更被她查出早安竟暗中订购往瑞士的机票。贾瑜约见早安，故意找来可人试饮有毒红酒，早安竟上前阻止；贾瑜道出早已把户口的钱转走，早安气得表示决裂，并带同可人离开。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 早安向可人表示另有计划，事成可获分一亿赎金，使可人答应协助。少男感快将入狱，遂向嘉嘉尽诉心事，两人情不自禁发生关系。少男独自向国强自首，嘉嘉赶来与少男分担罪名；早安在美华身上设置监听器，因而发现她与国强的关系。戴波捉走俊朗更与早安大打出手，最终俊朗落在早安手中。贾瑜将俊朗在早安手上的消息告知展龙，但他以被停职为由拒绝协助。嘉嘉与少男请国强为他们主持简单的婚礼，好让在入狱前结为夫妇。酒店正式解封，贾瑜等人差点被早安施调虎离山计逃走，幸得展龙眼利把他捉住，酒店忽然大爆炸。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #24 [粤]
programme.desc: 嘉被姑丈邹鼎昌带返家中唠叨，更与表姊邹楚娟争吵过后愤而离开。嘉在便利店被弄污衣衫，欲于洗手间清理却遇劫匪，但嘉却因此发现安的门匙，准备交还却发现家中无人，于是趁机梳洗沐浴，不料竟睡到天明。当与刚返家的安相遇尴尬不已时，却被母亲邱鸿雪撞见，更误会二人关系。安见状便提出以五千元一天代价要求嘉扮作其新婚妻子，不料雪指有要事未能前来。嘉见安在酒会上揭穿雪公司面临困境一事时的反应大惑不解，嘉主动找雪了解真相，终了解事情来龙去脉，更解开母子长久间的心结。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #25 [粤]
programme.desc: 嘉与安展开同居生活，一反方家安身旁友人同事所料，嘉未有胡乱挥霍，二人共写意优游，自由自在的享受生活，贞更教嘉买性感内衣增添情趣。嘉偕同儿逛海味铺时，惊见昌竟有外遇，但嘉未有揭穿反帮忙隐瞒，只可惜始终功亏一篑。昌欲挽无从，只有坦诚认错，儿提出离婚。在杰等规劝下，终决定给予机会，但杰从此被严加管束限制，嘉却慨叹数十年婚姻关系仅剩一纸书文。安到台湾公干，贞闻讯要嘉趁机借出地方办宴会，更带同猪朋狗友到访，嘉无力阻挠，唯有尽力控制场面，不料安竟提早返港，撞见家中一片狼藉的景象。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #91 [粤]
programme.desc: 会议上，冰冰拿起一包薯片却无法打开，但同和取过薯片，打开吃一片后放回中央，冰冰知道同和是帮自己，暗喜。同和为找模特儿而苦恼，国仁建议他找宝拉或冰冰，同和最终使冰冰答应协助。冰冰带同自制蛋糕上班，尧坚与宝拉取笑同和利用新专题约会冰冰，同和坚持是因为模特儿太贵，才接受冰冰这廉价劳工，冰冰气结。众人不停批评冰冰的蛋糕，廸高却吃得津津有味……同和从国仁口中得知冰冰答应廸高的约会，匆匆往找廸高，认真地向廸高道出他决定追求冰冰，并赶往码头找她，他并没有注意到餐厅内还有云廷……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #92 [粤]
programme.desc: 国仁得知大德再次被拖欠酒数，决定助他找素岳及Herman讨回费用。国仁往找素岳反被他催交稿件；Herman解释是一德国客人款待财务部，然而该名客人是闫器的好友。国仁和大德在餐厅商讨如何还款予汝大，看到绮琴追同事的六元报纸费，大德佩服不已。绮琴得知旧同学将藉聚会派喜帖，遂提出只要国仁假扮其男友赴约便给他二千元报酬，贫穷的国仁内心挣扎；大德心生一计。聚会上，绮琴的旧同学看到风度翩翩的大德出现，以及他对绮琴关怀备至，自卑不已；大德成功为绮琴挽回面子，却未接受那二千元的回报……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #93 [粤]
programme.desc: 众《潮》人正投诉员工餐厅没有清汤腩供应时，却看见迟来的励军拿著清汤腩，才发现刚刚换了餐单。国仁竟愿意和尧坚对调食物，素岳认定两人秘密拍拖。众人发现国仁和尧坚下班后一起离去，认定二人发展地下情……大德无法联络国仁修理电灯，殷赏反指国仁拍拖不欲别人打扰才会关电话。殷赏和大德合力修理电灯不果，大德看到殷赏失落，断定殷赏对国仁有一定感情。尧坚巧遇电话无电的殷赏，建议殷赏可摇控飞线并借用她的电话，殷赏欣然接受。殷赏完成访问，突然接到国仁的示爱来电……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰认定沅宛妒忌而捉去大阿哥，但沅宛发誓不是自己所为；沅宛往找静贵人问责，但她矢口否认。太医证实道光患有偏头痛，建议以微量鸦片止痛，道光大惊并坚拒服用。舒明阿接到有关鸦片的密报后打算偷龙转凤，谁不知东窗事发。舒明阿招认一切，唯独拒绝承认劫走颐龄一事，道光一气之下决定将其处斩。穆章阿向太后报告借刀除去舒明阿之计成功，加上近日庆亲王因严打鸦片而激起民愤，相信成就大事之期指日可待；道光难抵头痛，打算试服少量鸦片，却甚感内疚，遂到佛堂祈求上天指引，未料因此而揭发沅宛与绵忻的奸情……

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #25 [粤]
programme.desc: 嘉与安展开同居生活，一反方家安身旁友人同事所料，嘉未有胡乱挥霍，二人共写意优游，自由自在的享受生活，贞更教嘉买性感内衣增添情趣。嘉偕同儿逛海味铺时，惊见昌竟有外遇，但嘉未有揭穿反帮忙隐瞒，只可惜始终功亏一篑。昌欲挽无从，只有坦诚认错，儿提出离婚。在杰等规劝下，终决定给予机会，但杰从此被严加管束限制，嘉却慨叹数十年婚姻关系仅剩一纸书文。安到台湾公干，贞闻讯要嘉趁机借出地方办宴会，更带同猪朋狗友到访，嘉无力阻挠，唯有尽力控制场面，不料安竟提早返港，撞见家中一片狼藉的景象。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #91 [粤]
programme.desc: 会议上，冰冰拿起一包薯片却无法打开，但同和取过薯片，打开吃一片后放回中央，冰冰知道同和是帮自己，暗喜。同和为找模特儿而苦恼，国仁建议他找宝拉或冰冰，同和最终使冰冰答应协助。冰冰带同自制蛋糕上班，尧坚与宝拉取笑同和利用新专题约会冰冰，同和坚持是因为模特儿太贵，才接受冰冰这廉价劳工，冰冰气结。众人不停批评冰冰的蛋糕，廸高却吃得津津有味……同和从国仁口中得知冰冰答应廸高的约会，匆匆往找廸高，认真地向廸高道出他决定追求冰冰，并赶往码头找她，他并没有注意到餐厅内还有云廷……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #92 [粤]
programme.desc: 国仁得知大德再次被拖欠酒数，决定助他找素岳及Herman讨回费用。国仁往找素岳反被他催交稿件；Herman解释是一德国客人款待财务部，然而该名客人是闫器的好友。国仁和大德在餐厅商讨如何还款予汝大，看到绮琴追同事的六元报纸费，大德佩服不已。绮琴得知旧同学将藉聚会派喜帖，遂提出只要国仁假扮其男友赴约便给他二千元报酬，贫穷的国仁内心挣扎；大德心生一计。聚会上，绮琴的旧同学看到风度翩翩的大德出现，以及他对绮琴关怀备至，自卑不已；大德成功为绮琴挽回面子，却未接受那二千元的回报……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #93 [粤]
programme.desc: 众《潮》人正投诉员工餐厅没有清汤腩供应时，却看见迟来的励军拿著清汤腩，才发现刚刚换了餐单。国仁竟愿意和尧坚对调食物，素岳认定两人秘密拍拖。众人发现国仁和尧坚下班后一起离去，认定二人发展地下情……大德无法联络国仁修理电灯，殷赏反指国仁拍拖不欲别人打扰才会关电话。殷赏和大德合力修理电灯不果，大德看到殷赏失落，断定殷赏对国仁有一定感情。尧坚巧遇电话无电的殷赏，建议殷赏可摇控飞线并借用她的电话，殷赏欣然接受。殷赏完成访问，突然接到国仁的示爱来电……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰认定沅宛妒忌而捉去大阿哥，但沅宛发誓不是自己所为；沅宛往找静贵人问责，但她矢口否认。太医证实道光患有偏头痛，建议以微量鸦片止痛，道光大惊并坚拒服用。舒明阿接到有关鸦片的密报后打算偷龙转凤，谁不知东窗事发。舒明阿招认一切，唯独拒绝承认劫走颐龄一事，道光一气之下决定将其处斩。穆章阿向太后报告借刀除去舒明阿之计成功，加上近日庆亲王因严打鸦片而激起民愤，相信成就大事之期指日可待；道光难抵头痛，打算试服少量鸦片，却甚感内疚，遂到佛堂祈求上天指引，未料因此而揭发沅宛与绵忻的奸情……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #17 [粤]
programme.desc: 展龙向贾瑜说出早安欲毒害她，安自辩开脱，贾瑜对早安深信不疑；戴波毒打少男与嘉嘉，幸得仕灿现身将两人救走。美华竟是生俊朗的代母，向国强了解俊朗多年来的生活，后悔当年收下二百万放弃儿子的抚养权。小茵出现早产症状，家燕与贾瑜遂合力扶她到医疗室，谁知电梯中途失灵，小茵被迫在内产子。贾瑜决定试探未婚夫，更被她查出早安竟暗中订购往瑞士的机票。贾瑜约见早安，故意找来可人试饮有毒红酒，早安竟上前阻止；贾瑜道出早已把户口的钱转走，早安气得表示决裂，并带同可人离开。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 早安向可人表示另有计划，事成可获分一亿赎金，使可人答应协助。少男感快将入狱，遂向嘉嘉尽诉心事，两人情不自禁发生关系。少男独自向国强自首，嘉嘉赶来与少男分担罪名；早安在美华身上设置监听器，因而发现她与国强的关系。戴波捉走俊朗更与早安大打出手，最终俊朗落在早安手中。贾瑜将俊朗在早安手上的消息告知展龙，但他以被停职为由拒绝协助。嘉嘉与少男请国强为他们主持简单的婚礼，好让在入狱前结为夫妇。酒店正式解封，贾瑜等人差点被早安施调虎离山计逃走，幸得展龙眼利把他捉住，酒店忽然大爆炸。

programme.desc: 展龙向贾瑜说出早安欲毒害她，安自辩开脱，贾瑜对早安深信不疑；戴波毒打少男与嘉嘉，幸得仕灿现身将两人救走。美华竟是生俊朗的代母，向国强了解俊朗多年来的生活，后悔当年收下二百万放弃儿子的抚养权。小茵出现早产症状，家燕与贾瑜遂合力扶她到医疗室，谁知电梯中途失灵，小茵被迫在内产子。贾瑜决定试探未婚夫，更被她查出早安竟暗中订购往瑞士的机票。贾瑜约见早安，故意找来可人试饮有毒红酒，早安竟上前阻止；贾瑜道出早已把户口的钱转走，早安气得表示决裂，并带同可人离开。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 早安向可人表示另有计划，事成可获分一亿赎金，使可人答应协助。少男感快将入狱，遂向嘉嘉尽诉心事，两人情不自禁发生关系。少男独自向国强自首，嘉嘉赶来与少男分担罪名；早安在美华身上设置监听器，因而发现她与国强的关系。戴波捉走俊朗更与早安大打出手，最终俊朗落在早安手中。贾瑜将俊朗在早安手上的消息告知展龙，但他以被停职为由拒绝协助。嘉嘉与少男请国强为他们主持简单的婚礼，好让在入狱前结为夫妇。酒店正式解封，贾瑜等人差点被早安施调虎离山计逃走，幸得展龙眼利把他捉住，酒店忽然大爆炸。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #25 [粤]
programme.desc: 陆与孙替星上诉，都被罚三十大板，孙激动，在堂上昏倒。杰参加孙葬礼，赫然发现孙为替星打官司而死，杰气极，决替星出头。在公堂上，杰质疑县官多打星十五大板，而偷鸡案发生在审讯之后，县官哑口无言，押后再审。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #26 [粤]
programme.desc: 知府与知县官官相卫，再击打杰三十大板。杰趁巡抚主考日告状，巡指责杰捣乱试埸，再判罚三十大板。杰四出告状，原来各巡抚均属湘军一系，杰找藩主持公道。杰上京，藩被作弄，藩随意一点，叫杰来解这灯谜。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #27 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰上庭呼冤，知县、知府、巡抚齐扮失忆，连案情记录亦不知所终。杰等四出派发三之画像，更利用丐帮势力，全力寻人。三位欲杀三灭口，杰机警，在大宅外放火，三乘乱逃走。杰见三，劝三作证，三心动，惜被黑衣人杀害。

programme.title: 天与地 #8 [粤]
programme.desc: 卓桦对以朗提防，派人核数。海晴示爱，俊雄婉言拒绝，并鼓励其尽心工运。雪薇和振轩目睹车祸伤者，振轩竟毫无惧意。梓恩借车给俊雄，俊雄忆起当年和梓恩点滴。耀彬透露爱意，佩玲婉拒。以朗躱在琴行彻夜弹结他发泄。

programme.title: 天与地 #9 [粤]
programme.desc: 卓桐被邀录广播节目，自感表现差；振轩练习失明生活，闭目烹调；劳资双方谈判勉强达成协议。勇觉得被工会出卖，上门淋漒水误伤海晴。泉婶病逝，兆泉自责害妻子一生贫困，劝俊雄出面参选立法会，为工人争取最大利益。

programme.title: 特技人 #12 [粤]
programme.desc: 知行得大志相助，找到掳走秦臻的车，随即被击晕带走，原来首领黎炭与大志相识，大志为救人拿刀自插。知行与昊荣的关系似有改善，化冰决定离间二人。注资电影的老板退资，知行误会昊荣前往质问，昊荣再度受刺激不适。俊民到黛儿公司赫见冠一，黛儿坦承冠一是她的儿子，俊民怒不可遏动粗。大志把黛儿接回家暂住，美姝刻意离家回避。大志劝雅琳向美姝坦白患有血癌，雅琳坚持不能再让美姝看到她死而痛苦，望大志成全。怎料事与愿违……

programme.title: 特技人 #13 [粤]
programme.desc: 美姝气愤被最信任的大志欺骗，离家到秦臻家暂住。美姝验出白血球数值偏高，担心自己患血癌。美姝接拍跳楼戏而危坐天台，大志怕她会做傻事而拯救，还坦白雅琳患癌一事。秦臻得美姝启发，建议振国开办网店，还透过大志接触黛儿谈合作。知行得知昊荣脑内有血管瘤，到医院探望却被保安阻挡，误会父亲不想见他。美姝到医院检验身体时感惊恐无助，幸大志陪伴左右。大志安排美姝母女见面，美姝忍不住质问雅琳当年离去原因，雅琳有口难言。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #28 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰、珑被拉回公堂，藩审判，知县、知府判罚三十大板，巡抚更杀三而被藩亲自操刀。太后突至，发现藩秘密审讯，藩与下属一律革职。俱乐部大火，烧死八国官员，杰自动请缨，与洋人谈判，但要藩陪同，太后惟有将藩复职。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰从张口中得知俱乐部内皆洋货，指出各国的劣质家私、食品及设备均是引致这埸猛烈火灾的原因，八国代表内疚非常，后对杰大为欣赏，张感醋意。照相佬约见杰，称事发当晚曾拍到有人手持火把，杰方知火灾一事并非意外。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #30 [粤]
programme.desc: (大结局)杰庭上道出真相，当日各外国人借醉强奸红，红吊颈自尽，张放火杀人。杰知张并未净身，与太后有染，太后怒极，要将杰处斩，纠缠间起火，杰被烧死，原来藩做了手脚，杰隐姓埋名，与珑等退隐田园，避人耳目。

programme.title: 天与地 #10 [粤]
programme.desc: 俊雄与兆泉誓言加入议会。振轩不慎淋雨发烧，病中想起当年旧事。俊雄找咏仪谈离婚，咏仪提议重新开始。以朗劝俊雄不要对梓恩存幻想，毕竟大家都吃过家明，没资格爱她。梓恩当面询问俊雄，俊雄坦承感觉只会藏于心底。

programme.title: 天与地 #11 [粤]
programme.desc: 记者采访俊雄与咏仪离婚事，咏仪澄清谣传。卓桦旧情人侯钊平自台湾将台湾司法部仍调查十年前的案件告知卓桦，卓桦明白钊平要胁。以朗对俊雄莫名妒忌，火烧其竞选海报泄愤。卓桐于街上撞见以朗偷情，伤心欲绝。

programme.title: 五味人生 #25 [粤]
programme.desc: (大结局)缉私队除发现船上藏有黄金外，更发现大批国宝；此时扬指是祯策画走私。九与春被释放回家，更说出祯主动认罪把所有罪名揹上身……拜神中的扬与岚被带至废屋，雄提出要他想办法把国宝偷回。扬发现岚只是装傻后，竟把岚绑架回家。天自扬与岚的对话中，发现一切都是扬的计谋，天不禁崩溃了……春不想祯枉死，决定与妹营救祯。在岚与天努力游说下，扬意欲自首，但娣这时竟抢去扬的手枪，更向岚开火……九独力缉捕雄，祯与春竟一起出现欲帮助他；三人不敌，雄竟提出在三人中只放过一人……

programme.title: 太极 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 孤儿马抢走军队猎杀的野猪后逃去。马家被宁烧毁，往找宁晦气，被围攻下惟有胁持宁儿子反锁屋内。青送饭菜，马吃后晕倒，原来青已在饭中下迷药。马、年两人决当兵，岂料到了战场，竟被要求杀害言子规及她的弟弟。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #28 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰、珑被拉回公堂，藩审判，知县、知府判罚三十大板，巡抚更杀三而被藩亲自操刀。太后突至，发现藩秘密审讯，藩与下属一律革职。俱乐部大火，烧死八国官员，杰自动请缨，与洋人谈判，但要藩陪同，太后惟有将藩复职。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰从张口中得知俱乐部内皆洋货，指出各国的劣质家私、食品及设备均是引致这埸猛烈火灾的原因，八国代表内疚非常，后对杰大为欣赏，张感醋意。照相佬约见杰，称事发当晚曾拍到有人手持火把，杰方知火灾一事并非意外。

programme.title: 万凰之王 #24 [粤]
programme.desc: 道光欲杀二阿哥，沅宛迫不得已道出当日痛失胎儿与亲母经过；绵忻愿意受刑，但恳求道光放过沅宛及二阿哥。道光下令将沅宛降为妃打入冷宫，绵忻出征边疆终身不得回宫。道光找静贵人相陪，竟目睹她在寝宫内公然吸食鸦片；伊兰得悉道光连续数天缺席早朝，斥责静贵人迷惑皇上。伊兰助道光戒除鸦片毒瘾，竟遇上天理教袭击，绵忻相助，更替道光挡箭受了重伤。伊兰与锷泰感行刺一事，暗中隐藏重大阴谋；太医指道光以鸦片治头痛而染上毒瘾，穆章阿提议道光到避暑山庄戒毒，大臣们提出由绵忻摄政，伊兰故意向乐欣透露真相……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 众人惊见酒店房间大爆炸，早安混乱中逃离现场；少男与嘉嘉向国强请罪，并打算向警方自首，但国强欲让两人离开。戴波把嘉嘉掳走，并质问她俊朗的下落。仕灿到医院探望小茵但不敢现身，当小茵向唐晶问及仕灿时，戴波与手下把两人捉走。早安把可人打晕后，带走俊朗并约见国强交赎金；早安安排国强、婉娴及美华在酒店的记者会出现，并要他当众道出曾做过的错事全港直播……贾瑜与展龙分头寻找早安下落，早安与展龙大打出手后逃走，正当他以为成功摆脱展龙时，贾瑜却早已看穿他；展龙为救俊朗被迫目送早安离开。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: (大结局)展龙成功赶至阻止俊朗身旁的炸弹爆炸，却发现装置只有倒数器并冇炸药；仕灿带钱往波贼巢赎小茵等人，却因赎金是假钞，加上少男持「炸药」到来唬吓失败，气得戴波大开杀戒。卓奇到酒店拘捕国强，展龙带同俊朗前来送别；警方拘捕少男与嘉嘉，俊朗竟指他们未有绑架自己。小茵与母亲等在医院巧遇仕灿，一家人终冰释前嫌。早安出海往梦想小岛生活时，被一小船拦截，来者正是贾瑜。一年后住客们出席「隔离一周年」派对，众人分享近况，展龙乘独处时了解贾瑜近况，她透露早安再次不辞而别。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #26 [粤]
programme.desc: 安见家中一片狼藉，嘉竟未有商量就趁集远行，带同大班朋友返家而动怒。冷静下来之后，终于从录影带中发现当晚真相，只见嘉尽力制止各人严守规矩，令安暗自苦笑。贞为求顺利一脚踏两船，费煞思量之余，更险被鹏发现真相。安到大牌档为嘉猜枚顶酒，以表自己已原谅嘉，二人正欲和好如初之际，却遇上欣登门造访。她声言欲重返安身旁，安为此惆怅不已，与嘉相对无言。昌再被撞破与内地妻子见面，更被发现私生子一同在公园用餐，令娟与儿痛感无可救药，嘉苦恼不已之际，找前度男友尚一吉倾诉，结果却惹来安误会二人关系。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #27 [粤]
programme.desc: 嘉和安终在误会重重下分手，二人表面潇洒，却难掩心中动摇。安将心神摆在事业上，不料却一时大意导致损失惨重。嘉在大食会上碰见刚与「男友」分手的吉，更互相开解安慰。另一边厢，贞准备与有妇之夫出游，却被对方妻子在机场揭穿真相，但贞仍振振有词直言丈夫有外遇是妻子问题。不料此幕却被鹏意外目睹，二人关系就此破裂。贞误报自我增值讲座，却因此让嘉与前度男友何保泰重遇，保泰更与嘉彻夜研究重开凤凰楼的具体计划，然而为听取专业分析找来的会计师友人，却正巧是安。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #94 [粤]
programme.desc: Suki代表叶氏集团和汝大等讨论环保砖项目，丽薇本志在必得，但提议均被Suki否决。Suki私下约会汝大和丽薇，丽薇看穿Suki借意亲近汝大。汝大听到众秘书绘声绘影地讨论他和Suki，估计是丽薇造谣。Suki以私务为由退出环保砖项目，并由其兄Ben负责。Ben的风格和丽薇无异，均以经济利益为先，汝大无奈。会议后汝大收到Suki来电，才得知其电脑被黑客入侵，认定是丽薇恶作剧。汝大往家找升诉苦，家升却使他有所启发。汝大往找Richard，直指他把入标价钱外泄……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #95 [粤]
programme.desc: 众秘书全天候严阵守候Ben，宝拉邀请他作为专访对象。宝拉在电梯巧遇Ben，更发现Ben的蛀牙传出臭味，但为了访问没有道出真相。秘书们与绮琴向宝拉打听Ben的资料，宝拉坚称内容须先让殷赏过目，众女不忿。绮琴发现Ben梦中情人的样貌跟美玲极为相似，决定重演他和初恋女友被困电梯的情景，女主角换成美玲。绮琴的精密部署却因美玲听错电梯编号而失败；反而造就了Ben和宝拉相遇。Ben和宝拉被困电梯半小时，被闭路电视拍下Ben激动地拥著她，使宝拉变成OL公敌。Ben更送来大束鲜花予宝拉……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #96 [粤]
programme.desc: 众男提醒国仁负责本周的家居清洁，被清洁员材叔听到，为国仁找来不少清洁用品。众男对于国仁与材成为好友感不屑。丽薇通知众人集团有仪式要求汝大出席；由于闫器的司机休息，殷赏托国仁接载汝大出席。此时材肚痛，汝大救人心切决定先以车送材入院。材突然喝令国仁停车，更持手枪指向汝大的头；材指闫器为富不仁，所以才到金波集团报复。材见国仁不愿离去，遂将他和汝大绑在货柜内；汝大欲偷袭材，反被他打伤。材扬言若未能在廿四小时内收到一亿赎款，两人将被炸至粉身碎骨。汝大表示闫器不在港；殷赏报警求助……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #24 [粤]
programme.desc: 道光欲杀二阿哥，沅宛迫不得已道出当日痛失胎儿与亲母经过；绵忻愿意受刑，但恳求道光放过沅宛及二阿哥。道光下令将沅宛降为妃打入冷宫，绵忻出征边疆终身不得回宫。道光找静贵人相陪，竟目睹她在寝宫内公然吸食鸦片；伊兰得悉道光连续数天缺席早朝，斥责静贵人迷惑皇上。伊兰助道光戒除鸦片毒瘾，竟遇上天理教袭击，绵忻相助，更替道光挡箭受了重伤。伊兰与锷泰感行刺一事，暗中隐藏重大阴谋；太医指道光以鸦片治头痛而染上毒瘾，穆章阿提议道光到避暑山庄戒毒，大臣们提出由绵忻摄政，伊兰故意向乐欣透露真相……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 众人惊见酒店房间大爆炸，早安混乱中逃离现场；少男与嘉嘉向国强请罪，并打算向警方自首，但国强欲让两人离开。戴波把嘉嘉掳走，并质问她俊朗的下落。仕灿到医院探望小茵但不敢现身，当小茵向唐晶问及仕灿时，戴波与手下把两人捉走。早安把可人打晕后，带走俊朗并约见国强交赎金；早安安排国强、婉娴及美华在酒店的记者会出现，并要他当众道出曾做过的错事全港直播……贾瑜与展龙分头寻找早安下落，早安与展龙大打出手后逃走，正当他以为成功摆脱展龙时，贾瑜却早已看穿他；展龙为救俊朗被迫目送早安离开。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: (大结局)展龙成功赶至阻止俊朗身旁的炸弹爆炸，却发现装置只有倒数器并冇炸药；仕灿带钱往波贼巢赎小茵等人，却因赎金是假钞，加上少男持「炸药」到来唬吓失败，气得戴波大开杀戒。卓奇到酒店拘捕国强，展龙带同俊朗前来送别；警方拘捕少男与嘉嘉，俊朗竟指他们未有绑架自己。小茵与母亲等在医院巧遇仕灿，一家人终冰释前嫌。早安出海往梦想小岛生活时，被一小船拦截，来者正是贾瑜。一年后住客们出席「隔离一周年」派对，众人分享近况，展龙乘独处时了解贾瑜近况，她透露早安再次不辞而别。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #26 [粤]
programme.desc: 安见家中一片狼藉，嘉竟未有商量就趁集远行，带同大班朋友返家而动怒。冷静下来之后，终于从录影带中发现当晚真相，只见嘉尽力制止各人严守规矩，令安暗自苦笑。贞为求顺利一脚踏两船，费煞思量之余，更险被鹏发现真相。安到大牌档为嘉猜枚顶酒，以表自己已原谅嘉，二人正欲和好如初之际，却遇上欣登门造访。她声言欲重返安身旁，安为此惆怅不已，与嘉相对无言。昌再被撞破与内地妻子见面，更被发现私生子一同在公园用餐，令娟与儿痛感无可救药，嘉苦恼不已之际，找前度男友尚一吉倾诉，结果却惹来安误会二人关系。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #27 [粤]
programme.desc: 嘉和安终在误会重重下分手，二人表面潇洒，却难掩心中动摇。安将心神摆在事业上，不料却一时大意导致损失惨重。嘉在大食会上碰见刚与「男友」分手的吉，更互相开解安慰。另一边厢，贞准备与有妇之夫出游，却被对方妻子在机场揭穿真相，但贞仍振振有词直言丈夫有外遇是妻子问题。不料此幕却被鹏意外目睹，二人关系就此破裂。贞误报自我增值讲座，却因此让嘉与前度男友何保泰重遇，保泰更与嘉彻夜研究重开凤凰楼的具体计划，然而为听取专业分析找来的会计师友人，却正巧是安。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #94 [粤]
programme.desc: Suki代表叶氏集团和汝大等讨论环保砖项目，丽薇本志在必得，但提议均被Suki否决。Suki私下约会汝大和丽薇，丽薇看穿Suki借意亲近汝大。汝大听到众秘书绘声绘影地讨论他和Suki，估计是丽薇造谣。Suki以私务为由退出环保砖项目，并由其兄Ben负责。Ben的风格和丽薇无异，均以经济利益为先，汝大无奈。会议后汝大收到Suki来电，才得知其电脑被黑客入侵，认定是丽薇恶作剧。汝大往家找升诉苦，家升却使他有所启发。汝大往找Richard，直指他把入标价钱外泄……

programme.desc: 安见家中一片狼藉，嘉竟未有商量就趁集远行，带同大班朋友返家而动怒。冷静下来之后，终于从录影带中发现当晚真相，只见嘉尽力制止各人严守规矩，令安暗自苦笑。贞为求顺利一脚踏两船，费煞思量之余，更险被鹏发现真相。安到大牌档为嘉猜枚顶酒，以表自己已原谅嘉，二人正欲和好如初之际，却遇上欣登门造访。她声言欲重返安身旁，安为此惆怅不已，与嘉相对无言。昌再被撞破与内地妻子见面，更被发现私生子一同在公园用餐，令娟与儿痛感无可救药，嘉苦恼不已之际，找前度男友尚一吉倾诉，结果却惹来安误会二人关系。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #27 [粤]
programme.desc: 嘉和安终在误会重重下分手，二人表面潇洒，却难掩心中动摇。安将心神摆在事业上，不料却一时大意导致损失惨重。嘉在大食会上碰见刚与「男友」分手的吉，更互相开解安慰。另一边厢，贞准备与有妇之夫出游，却被对方妻子在机场揭穿真相，但贞仍振振有词直言丈夫有外遇是妻子问题。不料此幕却被鹏意外目睹，二人关系就此破裂。贞误报自我增值讲座，却因此让嘉与前度男友何保泰重遇，保泰更与嘉彻夜研究重开凤凰楼的具体计划，然而为听取专业分析找来的会计师友人，却正巧是安。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #95 [粤]
programme.desc: 众秘书全天候严阵守候Ben，宝拉邀请他作为专访对象。宝拉在电梯巧遇Ben，更发现Ben的蛀牙传出臭味，但为了访问没有道出真相。秘书们与绮琴向宝拉打听Ben的资料，宝拉坚称内容须先让殷赏过目，众女不忿。绮琴发现Ben梦中情人的样貌跟美玲极为相似，决定重演他和初恋女友被困电梯的情景，女主角换成美玲。绮琴的精密部署却因美玲听错电梯编号而失败；反而造就了Ben和宝拉相遇。Ben和宝拉被困电梯半小时，被闭路电视拍下Ben激动地拥著她，使宝拉变成OL公敌。Ben更送来大束鲜花予宝拉……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #96 [粤]
programme.desc: 众男提醒国仁负责本周的家居清洁，被清洁员材叔听到，为国仁找来不少清洁用品。众男对于国仁与材成为好友感不屑。丽薇通知众人集团有仪式要求汝大出席；由于闫器的司机休息，殷赏托国仁接载汝大出席。此时材肚痛，汝大救人心切决定先以车送材入院。材突然喝令国仁停车，更持手枪指向汝大的头；材指闫器为富不仁，所以才到金波集团报复。材见国仁不愿离去，遂将他和汝大绑在货柜内；汝大欲偷袭材，反被他打伤。材扬言若未能在廿四小时内收到一亿赎款，两人将被炸至粉身碎骨。汝大表示闫器不在港；殷赏报警求助……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #24 [粤]
programme.desc: 道光欲杀二阿哥，沅宛迫不得已道出当日痛失胎儿与亲母经过；绵忻愿意受刑，但恳求道光放过沅宛及二阿哥。道光下令将沅宛降为妃打入冷宫，绵忻出征边疆终身不得回宫。道光找静贵人相陪，竟目睹她在寝宫内公然吸食鸦片；伊兰得悉道光连续数天缺席早朝，斥责静贵人迷惑皇上。伊兰助道光戒除鸦片毒瘾，竟遇上天理教袭击，绵忻相助，更替道光挡箭受了重伤。伊兰与锷泰感行刺一事，暗中隐藏重大阴谋；太医指道光以鸦片治头痛而染上毒瘾，穆章阿提议道光到避暑山庄戒毒，大臣们提出由绵忻摄政，伊兰故意向乐欣透露真相……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 众人惊见酒店房间大爆炸，早安混乱中逃离现场；少男与嘉嘉向国强请罪，并打算向警方自首，但国强欲让两人离开。戴波把嘉嘉掳走，并质问她俊朗的下落。仕灿到医院探望小茵但不敢现身，当小茵向唐晶问及仕灿时，戴波与手下把两人捉走。早安把可人打晕后，带走俊朗并约见国强交赎金；早安安排国强、婉娴及美华在酒店的记者会出现，并要他当众道出曾做过的错事全港直播……贾瑜与展龙分头寻找早安下落，早安与展龙大打出手后逃走，正当他以为成功摆脱展龙时，贾瑜却早已看穿他；展龙为救俊朗被迫目送早安离开。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: (大结局)展龙成功赶至阻止俊朗身旁的炸弹爆炸，却发现装置只有倒数器并冇炸药；仕灿带钱往波贼巢赎小茵等人，却因赎金是假钞，加上少男持「炸药」到来唬吓失败，气得戴波大开杀戒。卓奇到酒店拘捕国强，展龙带同俊朗前来送别；警方拘捕少男与嘉嘉，俊朗竟指他们未有绑架自己。小茵与母亲等在医院巧遇仕灿，一家人终冰释前嫌。早安出海往梦想小岛生活时，被一小船拦截，来者正是贾瑜。一年后住客们出席「隔离一周年」派对，众人分享近况，展龙乘独处时了解贾瑜近况，她透露早安再次不辞而别。

programme.title: 万凰之王 #25 [粤]
programme.desc: 乐欣开始相信伊兰的说话，遂前往冷宫试探沅宛；绵忻回家惊见乐欣昏迷，后太医诊实她已服用过量鸦片身亡。伊兰慰问穆章阿，他坦言心知是谁害死乐欣，伊兰借此劝穆章阿回头是岸但不果。众妃嫔请锷泰为她们绘画像，以送到避暑山庄让道光解相思之苦，琳贵人却发现锷泰的画卷内藏有伊兰的情诗，怀疑二人有暧昧行为。伊兰凭特制墨汁证实被诬陷，并与锷泰联手试出静贵人立心不良；最后更查出静贵人用提炼鸦片的材料制作梅花汤，让道光染上鸦片毒瘾。被软禁的静贵人难忍毒瘾发作，竟于深夜放火烧毁两位小阿哥居住的地方。

programme.title: 冲呀! 瘦薪兵团 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 高得科技研发部产品设计师巫雅历才华洋溢，与市场部的高级主任闵家华是好兄弟。雅历女友宁宁静在慈善机构工作，因职场斗争意兴阑珊，决定辞职；雅历妹妹健儿任职保险公司，以买楼为目标。总务部主管车咏娴在会议上故意挑剔，雅历和家华还以颜色。咏娴要求研发部主管林叔提早退休，林叔向雅历表示，已把提升他为研发部经理的信件交给老板高伟霆。雅历获悉伟霆因太太中风入院，无暇打理公司，老板不在，公司骤然变天。

programme.title: 冲呀! 瘦薪兵团 #2 [粤]
programme.desc: 家华与雅历升职计划被搁置，刚巧知道伟霆太太爱莲留医，家华二人于去找伟霆，无功而回。咏娴安排表妹王瑞萃照顾爱莲，为咏娴作内应，雅历欲向伟霆揭发咏娴恶行；Dickson得知宁静认识城中阔太司马太，要胁健儿介绍宁静到保险公司工作，否则解雇她。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #28 [粤]
programme.desc: 安直指计划书的不是，让会面在气氛尴尬之下结束；然而泰鼓励嘉找来亲朋戚友入股集资，初步略见小成。然而对泰的示爱，嘉却以专注事业为拒。儿为消磨时间到服务中心当义工，不料令长者们争风吃醋成为新闻焦点。娟等子女非但未有谅解，反怪责儿惹祸上身，被嘉直斥其非。贞因前男友身患爱滋病而认定自己凶多吉少，但鹏不离不弃更开解关怀，令二人关系更胜从前。安失意于旧公司，决意转往上海发展，欣默默支持相伴左右。泰受合伙人拖累被押返加国，凤凰楼发展计划因此顿挫；与此同时，嘉竟发现意外怀孕。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 安在阴差阳错下，未知真相就北上内地发展。嘉则决定当个不婚妈妈，加上灵机一触之下，决定改变计划将凤凰楼以私房菜方式发展。时光飞逝，十个月后，安与嘉竟不期而遇，骤见对方已为商界女强人，让安感慨唏嘘。然而从邓鹏口中，安得知吉并非婴孩父亲，且二人并未有结婚。安在狐疑下决定亲访凤凰楼欲了解真相，在吉安排下，安更有机会照顾嘉之子。不料一时疏忽之下，竟意外让婴儿吞下钻石，幸送院后并无大碍。因雪约同用膳，嘉得知婚期将近，以为安终与欣走在一起，加上安竟力争抚养权，令嘉反感。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #97 [粤]
programme.desc: 殷赏向何警司坦言怀疑丽薇没有能力营救汝大，丽薇拿著一亿赎款赶来；殷赏坚持到交收地点监视丽薇，家升虽不赞成，仍陪伴前往。国仁和汝大相处一晚后加深了解；国仁利用万字夹轻易为汝大解开手铐，相反汝大右手受伤未能为国仁解锁，国仁只好豁出去欲舍身成仁，汝大无言。殷赏正确推断材欲交收赎金的地点，更无意中救回昏倒在街上的材。材被送往医院，众人追问藏参地点，材只为自己计划得逞而哈哈大笑，殷赏等无不惊慌。国仁把心底话告知汝大，希望他代为转达予殷赏，汝大动容。当炸弹倒数至零时……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #98 [粤]
programme.desc: 宝拉与行家到街市采访与黑社会龙哥结怨。有神秘男子给宝拉送上鲜花，迪高认为是龙所为，殷赏亦担心不已。国仁发现宝拉被跟踪，她亦开始感到威胁。殷赏与家升商量宝拉之事，家升却认为殷赏过敏。殷赏和国仁分别打探龙的底蕴；殷赏在酒楼盘算找龙见面，突见宝拉独自出现。家升赶至劝喻两人切勿轻举妄动。岂料殷赏等人因不慎看见龙的走私军火而被擒；宝拉突然接到母亲来电，龙示意按下扩音器让宝拉接听，以免其母起疑，龙听到没有异样便继续进行军火买卖。突然房门被破开，一大队警员冲入……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #99 [粤]
programme.desc: 会议上，殷赏表示欲撰写卧底故事，并安排现役警司接受访问，宝拉听到被访者是诗卿时，不禁错愕。殷赏和宝拉往访诗卿，宝拉和诗卿装作素未谋面。诗卿受访内容竟正是宝拉曾负责的案件，使宝拉忆起这段时间在《潮》的生活。卧底的任务曾令宝拉感到无助，多次差点被识穿之际，乐儿均会犹如救星般出现在宝拉眼前，故此宝拉对乐儿心存感激。宝拉加入《潮》后，不是偷取高层的电脑资料，便是收集碎纸机内的文件，对卧底工作感泄气，幸好同事间的真挚感情，令宝拉得以支撑下去，并不知不觉间爱上《潮》记者这份工作……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #25 [粤]
programme.desc: 乐欣开始相信伊兰的说话，遂前往冷宫试探沅宛；绵忻回家惊见乐欣昏迷，后太医诊实她已服用过量鸦片身亡。伊兰慰问穆章阿，他坦言心知是谁害死乐欣，伊兰借此劝穆章阿回头是岸但不果。众妃嫔请锷泰为她们绘画像，以送到避暑山庄让道光解相思之苦，琳贵人却发现锷泰的画卷内藏有伊兰的情诗，怀疑二人有暧昧行为。伊兰凭特制墨汁证实被诬陷，并与锷泰联手试出静贵人立心不良；最后更查出静贵人用提炼鸦片的材料制作梅花汤，让道光染上鸦片毒瘾。被软禁的静贵人难忍毒瘾发作，竟于深夜放火烧毁两位小阿哥居住的地方。

programme.desc: 殷赏向何警司坦言怀疑丽薇没有能力营救汝大，丽薇拿著一亿赎款赶来；殷赏坚持到交收地点监视丽薇，家升虽不赞成，仍陪伴前往。国仁和汝大相处一晚后加深了解；国仁利用万字��轻易为汝大解开手铐，相反汝大右手受伤未能为国仁解锁，国仁只好豁出去欲舍身成仁，汝大无言。殷赏正确推断材欲交收赎金的地点，更无意中救回昏倒在街上的材。材被送往医院，众人追问藏参地点，材只为自己计划得逞而哈哈大笑，殷赏等无不惊慌。国仁把心底话告知汝大，希望他代为转达予殷赏，汝大动容。当炸弹倒数至零时……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #98 [粤]
programme.desc: 宝拉与行家到街市采访与黑社会龙哥结怨。有神秘男子给宝拉送上鲜花，迪高认为是龙所为，殷赏亦担心不已。国仁发现宝拉被跟踪，她亦开始感到威胁。殷赏与家升商量宝拉之事，家升却认为殷赏过敏。殷赏和国仁分别打探龙的底蕴；殷赏在酒楼盘算找龙见面，突见宝拉独自出现。家升赶至劝喻两人切勿轻举妄动。岂料殷赏等人因不慎看见龙的走私军火而被擒；宝拉突然接到母亲来电，龙示意按下扩音器让宝拉接听，以免其母起疑，龙听到没有异样便继续进行军火买卖。突然房门被破开，一大队警员冲入……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #99 [粤]
programme.desc: 会议上，殷赏表示欲撰写卧底故事，并安排现役警司接受访问，宝拉听到被访者是诗卿时，不禁错愕。殷赏和宝拉往访诗卿，宝拉和诗卿装作素未谋面。诗卿受访内容竟正是宝拉曾负责的案件，使宝拉忆起这段时间在《潮》的生活。卧底的任务曾令宝拉感到无助，多次差点被识穿之际，乐儿均会犹如救星般出现在宝拉眼前，故此宝拉对乐儿心存感激。宝拉加入《潮》后，不是偷取高层的电脑资料，便是收集碎纸机内的文件，对卧底工作感泄气，幸好同事间的真挚感情，令宝拉得以支撑下去，并不知不觉间爱上《潮》记者这份工作……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #25 [粤]
programme.desc: 乐欣开始相信伊兰的说话，遂前往冷宫试探沅宛；绵忻回家惊见乐欣昏迷，后太医诊实她已服用过量鸦片身亡。伊兰慰问穆章阿，他坦言心知是谁害死乐欣，伊兰借此劝穆章阿回头是岸但不果。众妃嫔请锷泰为她们绘画像，以送到避暑山庄让道光解相思之苦，琳贵人却发现锷泰的画卷内藏有伊兰的情诗，怀疑二人有暧昧行为。伊兰凭特制墨汁证实被诬陷，并与锷泰联手试出静贵人立心不良；最后更查出静贵人用提炼鸦片的材料制作梅花汤，让道光染上鸦片毒瘾。被软禁的静贵人难忍毒瘾发作，竟于深夜放火烧毁两位小阿哥居住的地方。

programme.title: 冲呀! 瘦薪兵团 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 高得科技研发部产品设计师巫雅历才华洋溢，与市场部的高级主任闵家华是好兄弟。雅历女友宁宁静在慈善机构工作，因职场斗争意兴阑珊，决定辞职；雅历妹妹健儿任职保险公司，以买楼为目标。总务部主管车咏娴在会议上故意挑剔，雅历和家华还以颜色。咏娴要求研发部主管林叔提早退休，林叔向雅历表示，已把提升他为研发部经理的信件交给老板高伟霆。雅历获悉伟霆因太太中风入院，无暇打理公司，老板不在，公司骤然变天。

programme.title: 冲呀! 瘦薪兵团 #2 [粤]
programme.desc: 家华与雅历升职计划被搁置，刚巧知道伟霆太太爱莲留医，家华二人于去找伟霆，无功而回。咏娴安排表妹王瑞萃照顾爱莲，为咏娴作内应，雅历欲向伟霆揭发咏娴恶行；Dickson得知宁静认识城中阔太司马太，要胁健儿介绍宁静到保险公司工作，否则解雇她。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #28 [粤]
programme.desc: 安直指计划书的不是，让会面在气氛尴尬之下结束；然而泰鼓励嘉找来亲朋戚友入股集资，初步略见小成。然而对泰的示爱，嘉却以专注事业为拒。儿为消磨时间到服务中心当义工，不料令长者们争风吃醋成为新闻焦点。娟等子女非但未有谅解，反怪责儿惹祸上身，被嘉直斥其非。贞因前男友身患爱滋病而认定自己凶多吉少，但鹏不离不弃更开解关怀，令二人关系更胜从前。安失意于旧公司，决意转往上海发展，欣默默支持相伴左右。泰受合伙人拖累被押返加国，凤凰楼发展计划因此顿挫；与此同时，嘉竟发现意外怀孕。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 安在阴差阳错下，未知真相就北上内地发展。嘉则决定当个不婚妈妈，加上灵机一触之下，决定改变计划将凤凰楼以私房菜方式发展。时光飞逝，十个月后，安与嘉竟不期而遇，骤见对方已为商界女强人，让安感慨唏嘘。然而从邓鹏口中，安得知吉并非婴孩父亲，且二人并未有结婚。安在狐疑下决定亲访凤凰楼欲了解真相，在吉安排下，安更有机会照顾嘉之子。不料一时疏忽之下，竟意外让婴儿吞下钻石，幸送院后并无大碍。因雪约同用膳，嘉得知婚期将近，以为安终与欣走在一起，加上安竟力争抚养权，令嘉反感。

programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报道艺人最新动态、剧集和电影宣传、演唱会精华、颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事、追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌、影、视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息。

programme.title: 灿烂的遗产 #34 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 流离失所的高恩诚在偶然机会下救了大财团会长一命，想不到竟被会长视如亲孙女般接返家，更获得遗产继承权。因祸得福的恩诚却因此遭受原本的继承人，会长的嫡孙鲜于焕敌意对待，于焕誓要夺回家族产业的控制权。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #242 [粤]
programme.desc: 康仔的皮肤出现问题，懋叔著众人小心燥热。斌仔涂了润唇膏，被陈积取笑。夜里，斌仔流鼻血，陈积则肚痛大作。陈积向老板推销洗头水，但他的头屑令老板却步。康仔以砂糖洗澡以滋润皮肤，夜里被蟑螂所咬，被众人取笑。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰无意中发现仲的车尾灯坏了一盏，联想屏遇害当晚所见，于是便向仲大兴问罪，反被仲以君做人质要胁警方，幸得飞机警解困。君觉得在飞心目中的地位不及芊，正想分手时，飞向她表白爱意。如请了洛伟基做经理，负责打理餐厅，由于他处事大公无私，令到餐厅上下都心服口服。邱Sir和缇在餐厅举行结婚纪念，专诚来餐厅试菜，遇到基的舅仔，觉得缇非常面熟。香和强感情越来越好，正计划结婚之际，强验出患上鼻咽癌。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #30 [粤]
programme.desc: 为了拒绝香的好意，和杰合作单打她，令香在酒吧借酒消愁时，遇到邱Sir，引致缇误会二人有私情。君觉得杰和强感情越来越好，反而父女的感情渐淡，飞安慰她；如醉心学习调酒，不惜到果园偷荔枝，园主说要告她令山啼笑皆非。缇看见邱Sir收藏香所送的银包非常生气，一怒之下离家，由于她整夜没有回家，令邱Sir非常担心，餐厅内的酒窖发现女尸，竟然是失踪的缇。兰计划出狱后离开香港，所以希望山不要再等，山心如刀割。

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #11 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #15 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #242 [粤]
programme.desc: 康仔的皮肤出现问题，懋叔著众人小心燥热。斌仔涂了润唇膏，被陈积取笑。夜里，斌仔流鼻血，陈积则肚痛大作。陈积向老板推销洗头水，但他的头屑令老板却步。康仔以砂糖洗澡以滋润皮肤，夜里被蟑螂所咬，被众人取笑。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #243 [粤]
programme.desc: 东华三院筹款，懋叔等人都慷慨解囊。顺嫂带著善款与牛太去电视台，途中其手袋被人撞跌，最后，拿了善款的人按著信封上的地址来找顺嫂，将善款归还，而威哥亦替陈积收回欠债，将钱悉数损出，大家各尽所能，共襄盛举。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #31 [粤]
programme.desc: 山知道兰的心意，决定接受分手事实。缇看见邱Sir收藏香所送的银包非常生气，一怒之下离家，由于她整夜没有回家，令邱Sir非常担心。餐厅内的酒窖发现女尸，竟然是失踪的缇。缇的尸体是由餐厅调酒师徐意志发现，警方盘问被餐厅解雇的陈珍妮，她只承认以匿名电话恐吓。山照例往邱Sir家中搜查，竟发现缇曾开出一张没有收票人记录的支票。另方面，山怀疑邱Sir与香合谋杀妻，香知道后大为气愤，遂指出曾见香与志在公众场合有不轨行为。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #32 [粤]
programme.desc: 警方集中调查志，志却采取不合作态度，原来当年他和缇一同留学法国学厨，但缇急于功利，偷了志的厨艺秘笈回港著书，且一举成名。志对她非常不满，但经过缇的真诚道歉，大家才冰释前嫌。餐厅解封后重新营业，志在清理酒窖时有所发现。青和权到餐厅晚膳，因权临时有事离开，两夫妻大骂一场。志中毒身亡，警方估计他杀死缇后畏罪自杀，如认为志为人积极,不会自杀。如险被新聘侍应林洛霞驾车撞死，原来霞认为如会欺骗其弟基的感情。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #244 [粤]
programme.desc: 陈积与老板谈生意，为去除口气而嚼香口胶，其后随便乱吐，老板不慎坐到香口胶上，要立即赶回家换裤。觉悟因随地吐痰，被卫生署职员票控，大感无奈。陈积再遇之前的老板，被他发现其乱吐香口胶的缺德行为，生意告吹。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #33 [粤]
programme.desc: 基的妻子因一名大意的司机不小心驾驶，弄致小产而自杀，基决意找出此人为妻报仇。警方查到酒窖并非杀缇的第一凶案现场，而是凶手将尸体移至酒窖嫁祸给志，还利用毒药毒死志，布局成像是志畏罪自杀一般。缇终沉冤得雪，邱Sir也感安慰。山约如吃饭，但山临时爽约，令如守候多时，山为表歉意，于是亲手弄海鲜饭给如以作道歉。如主以真诚打动山，令他决定接受如。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #34 [粤]
programme.desc: 山公开和如拍拖，兰知道后也祝福他们。青表弟辉仔暂住青家，由于小孩的童真，令青和权关系得到改善。飞再遇雄前妻娥，娥已嫁大厨Frankie，且生活幸福，飞答应娥不会向他人旧事重提。贵利钱永财被人谋财害命，辉仔目击凶手是他的救命恩人，于是不愿把样貌拼出来，只拼出他旁边的女人，警方怀疑财前同居女友仪联同男友光杀死财。辉仔险遭灭口，而飞亦收到匿名信提供真凶资料，在飞的追查下，发现娥竟是拼出来的神秘女郎。

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #13 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #17 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 灿烂的遗产 #36 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 流离失所的高恩诚在偶然机会下救了大财团会长一命，想不到竟被会长视如亲孙女般接返家，更获得遗产继承权。因祸得福的恩诚却因此遭受原本的继承人，会长的嫡孙鲜于焕敌意对待，于焕誓要夺回家族产业的控制权。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #244 [粤]
programme.desc: 陈积与老板谈生意，为去除口气而嚼香口胶，其后随便乱吐，老板不慎坐到香口胶上，要立即赶回家换裤。觉悟因随地吐痰，被卫生署职员票控，大感无奈。陈积再遇之前的老板，被他发现其乱吐香口胶的缺德行为，生意告吹。

programme.title: 香港原味道 #3 [粤]
programme.desc: 香港手制红枣核桃糕制作工序繁复，买少见少。这款老牌小食得以延续，有赖糖果厂一家坚持推广传统味道。见阿谭、庭锋拆枣拆到手软，幸美、德丞合力筛走……核桃，便知制作过程绝不容易。两位男士落模时效率奇低，究竟发生何事？烹饪教室创办人以花生、米通，制作香口、脆卜卜鸟结糖，一食就知是香港味道。另一种本土糖果特色，非本地潮语手拉糖莫属！经过师傅搓糖、拉糖，再人手拼拼砌砌，手工糖果「魔法」变出甚么字？

programme.title: 法证先锋II #3 [粤]
programme.desc: 逸升安全地引爆炸弹，他与琛原来是多年好友。英知最近有大学生因食正鸿所卖丸仔失控，冲出马路被撞死。博取得凶案当天的雨量分布图，证明志文说谎。英要求跟柔等人听取志文之口供，此时博赶至说另有内情。

programme.title: 法证先锋II #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 英见正鸿的死已水落石出，代正鸿送棒球棍给儿子作生日礼物。琛发现纹身贴纸，以此为线索将炸弹杀手绳之于法。英顺利大破贵筹划的毒品交易，当贵逃走时遇上汀与柔，汀发现贵的房车底装有炸弹，炸弹爆炸时汀走避不及。

programme.title: 法证先锋II #5 [粤]
programme.desc: 汀返魂无术，琛决心为汀讨回公道。升向博提出欲加入法证科工作。柔苏醒，得知自己伤势严重，情绪低落。英被调到重案组工作，雄等大感不满。沛沛与立仁从美国回港参加汀的丧礼，博安慰沛，却被仁误会二人旧情复炽。

programme.desc: 香港手制红枣核桃糕制作工序繁复，买少见少。这款老牌小食得以延续，有赖糖果厂一家坚持推广传统味道。见阿谭、庭锋拆枣拆到手软，幸美、德丞合力筛走……核桃，便知制作过程绝不容易。两位男士落模时效率奇低，究竟发生何事？烹饪教室创办人以花生、米通，制作香口、脆卜卜鸟结糖，一食就知是香港味道。另一种本土糖果特色，非本地潮语手拉糖莫属！经过师傅搓糖、拉糖，再人手拼拼砌砌，手工糖果「魔法」变出甚么字？

programme.title: 法证先锋II #3 [粤]
programme.desc: 逸升安全地引爆炸弹，他与琛原来是多年好友。英知最近有大学生因食正鸿所卖丸仔失控，冲出马路被撞死。博取得凶案当天的雨量分布图，证明志文说谎。英要求跟柔等人听取志文之口供，此时博赶至说另有内情。

programme.title: 法证先锋II #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 英见正鸿的死已水落石出，代正鸿送棒球棍给儿子作生日礼物。琛发现纹身贴纸，以此为线索将炸弹杀手绳之于法。英顺利大破贵筹划的毒品交易，当贵逃走时遇上汀与柔，汀发现贵的房车底装有炸弹，炸弹爆炸时汀走避不及。

programme.title: 出走地图 #19 [粤/普]
programme.desc: 朱祐宏、苏子芸前往槟城著名的汕头街夜市，搜寻地道美食。除了入口即融的鸡脚、零味精的鲜甜粿条汤，炒粿条、鸭粥粿汁、四果汤亦是必吃之选。二人及后乘缆车登上升旗山，细赏野生夜猴的生态，再踏足山上最高的观景台，360度饱览周围景色！一间传统娘惹糕工厂，供应多款「一啖一件」的特色糕点，祐宏、子芸吃不停！主持们还会随旅游达人，试吃印度瓦锅烤饼。置身逾百年历史的英式殖民建筑物，品尝马来风印度料理，又是甚么滋味？

programme.title: 出走地图 #20 [粤/普]
programme.desc: 祐宏、子芸乘人力车漫游槟城乔治市，发掘遍布大街小巷的壁画作品，顺道欣赏新旧兼容的建筑文化。一间以白色为主调的英国殖民风餐厅，成为人气打卡点。主持们享用下午茶后，参观设计精致的酒店房间，并置身顶楼泳池饱览海峡美景。亚参叻沙是当地必吃美食，浓郁虾羔加上各式配料，酸辣惹味。热辣过后，再尝一碗清凉的煎蕊，暑气尽消。二人及后勇闯水陆冒险主题乐园，挑战高空绳索设施；再走进水上太空舱，从高处冲入水面，认真刺激！

programme.title: 蓝色生死恋 #12 [韩]
programme.desc: 小时候的尹俊熙因为贪玩把恩熙跟芯爱的名牌弄乱导致护士阴错阳差的把两名婴儿的名牌搞错。原本在幸福美满家庭中长大的俊熙和恩熙兄妹，却在一次车祸中，因为血液检查而得知了真相的恩熙，一夕之间变成了灰姑娘...

programme.title: Running Man (XXII) #663 [韩]
programme.desc: 今集成员们一同进行"绘画之旅"竞赛。由刘在锡进行作画拿给市民看后提问，并且只能前往市民回答的地方。若在4点前成功抵达制作组指定的3处郊游地点即可下班，反之则全员搭乘惊险万分的摇摆圆盘受罚。敬请期待。

programme.desc: 祐宏、子芸乘人力车漫游槟城乔治市，发掘遍布大街小巷的壁画作品，顺道欣赏新旧兼容的建筑文化。一间以白色为主调的英国殖民风餐厅，成为人气打卡点。主持们享用下午茶后，参观设计精致的酒店房间，并置身顶楼泳池饱览海峡美景。亚参叻沙是当地必吃美食，浓郁虾羔加上各式配料，酸辣惹味。热辣过后，再尝一碗清凉的煎蕊，暑气尽消。二人及后勇闯水陆冒险主题乐园，挑战高空绳索设施；再走进水上太空舱，从高处冲入水面，认真刺激！

programme.title: 蓝色生死恋 #12 [韩]
programme.desc: 小时候的尹俊熙因为贪玩把恩熙跟芯爱的名牌弄乱导致护士阴错阳差的把两名婴儿的名牌搞错。原本在幸福美满家庭中长大的俊熙和恩熙兄妹，却在一次车祸中，因为血液检查而得知了真相的恩熙，一夕之间变成了灰姑娘...

programme.title: Running Man (XXII) #663 [韩]
programme.desc: 今集成员们一同进行"绘画之旅"竞赛。由刘在锡进行作画拿给市民看后提问，并且只能前往市民回答的地方。若在4点前成功抵达制作组指定的3处郊游地点即可下班，反之则全员搭乘惊险万分的摇摆圆盘受罚。敬请期待。

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #14 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #18 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 优雅的新娘 #1 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 三十年前一个晚上，白山为了独揽天山花楸再生霜的生意，而杀死了称兄道弟的日锡，随后更烧屋摧毁证据。白山老婆和日锡老婆同在当晚生产；白山的双胞胎其中一个救不回来，替日锡老婆接生的白山妈妈萌生了邪恶的念头…

programme.title: 香港 '83 #245 [粤]
programme.desc: 懋叔的耳朵似有点毛病，但他不以为意，最后越来越严重，竟听不到其他人的话。医生说懋叔是耳垢太多所致，他得悉后松一口气。陈积双耳肿痛，医生说他耳朵发炎。苏小姐等人合计作弄他，让他以为自己聋了，大为紧张。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #35 [粤]
programme.desc: 原来娥被刚相识的康骗财骗色后，还被勒索，只好求助飞。光被人发现伏尸酒店，根据娥所形容的神秘人特征，怀疑是光的兄长林浩天，不过天在案发当晚一直在医院陪伴妻子，且有当值护士证明。强的癌病受到控制，于是他勇敢地向香表明一切，香亦重新接纳他。娥一再被人勒索，飞屡劝娥跟警方合作，反被娥说服私下帮她寻找真凶。山欲利用职权令飞供出娥，飞坚拒透露，山唯有拘捕飞。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #36 [粤]
programme.desc: 飞权衡职责后，终将有关娥的一切告诉山，山听后明白娥的处境。娥怀疑遭飞出卖,再没有面目见Frankie,娥决自杀解脱，幸君及时阻止，娥亦愿意和警方合作。仪失踪，警方估计她已凶多吉少，但没有发现任何线索，最后由飞作出大胆假设，凶手原形毕露。娥欲返回大陆隐居，Frankie急忙赶往车站,却不幸被旅游车撞至倒下。飞带君至芊旧居，并对君说回忆芊巳非个人秘密，更希望与君共同踏入人生另一阶段。

programme.desc: 懋叔的耳朵似有点毛病，但他不以为意，最后越来越严重，竟听不到其他人的话。医生说懋叔是耳垢太多所致，他得悉后松一口气。陈积双耳肿痛，医生说他耳朵发炎。苏小姐等人合计作弄他，让他以为自己聋了，大为紧张。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #35 [粤]
programme.desc: 原来娥被刚相识的康骗财骗色后，还被勒索，只好求助飞。光被人发现伏尸酒店，根据娥所形容的神秘人特征，怀疑是光的兄长林浩天，不过天在案发当晚一直在医院陪伴妻子，且有当值护士证明。强的癌病受到控制，于是他勇敢地向香表明一切，香亦重新接纳他。娥一再被人勒索，飞屡劝娥跟警方合作，反被娥说服私下帮她寻找真凶。山欲利用职权令飞供出娥，飞坚拒透露，山唯有拘捕飞。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #36 [粤]
programme.desc: 飞权衡职责后，终将有关娥的一切告诉山，山听后明白娥的处境。娥怀疑遭飞出卖,再没有面目见Frankie,娥决自杀解脱，幸君及时阻止，娥亦愿意和警方合作。仪失踪，警方估计她已凶多吉少，但没有发现任何线索，最后由飞作出大胆假设，凶手原形毕露。娥欲返回大陆隐居，Frankie急忙赶往车站,却不幸被旅游车撞至倒下。飞带君至芊旧居，并对君说回忆芊巳非个人秘密，更希望与君共同踏入人生另一阶段。

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #14 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #18 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 优雅的新娘 #2 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 仁顺得知小风不是自己的亲生女儿后，疯了似地把小风赶出门。蓉慈害怕东窗事发，便让仁顺误以为小风是白山的私生女，并告诉白山真相，却意外地被在河听见，心存怀疑的在河编造了一个不存在的证据，欲试探白山的反应…

programme.title: 香港 '83 #246 [粤]
programme.desc: 牛太与顺嫂买海鲜弄大餐，饭后牛太将垃圾扔在懋叔后巷。垃圾佬来收垃圾，顺嫂经过被垃圾佬指责。威哥与垃圾佬起争执，垃圾佬辞职，威哥负责处理垃圾。陈积著斌仔将垃圾丢后巷，威哥以为是牛生所为，幸最后真相大白。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #37 [粤]
programme.desc: 权被派往美国工作，青拒绝跟随，夫妻形同分居，令山和如更珍惜现在关系。兰刑满出狱，为斩断与山的情丝，宁和曾同监的彤和其兄豪一起居住。兰找工作处处碰壁，幸得影视红星田思思赏识，聘为私人助理，兰更在彤的餐厅兼职。君和飞感情猛进，飞为忘记芊，决将芊的房屋出售，君以为飞真的巳放开心结。警方发现一女尸，飞认为可能是芊，整个人显得失魂落魄。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #38 [粤]
programme.desc: 警方证实女尸是美容师曼，但君已决意和飞分手。明星华宝晶在家中被杀，兰无意中听到凶手声音，成为唯一认得凶手的证人。兰勇敢地重返昔日工作的警署做证人，令山非常佩服。思待兰像朋友一般，令兰工作愉快。警方发觉晶和思同属一经理人Philip，案发当日他们亦一起工作。彤结识了新男友，并答应在豪生日当晚带他回家，可是彤却失了踪影。彤的尸体被发现弃于海边，验尸报告发现她体内留有鸡糠。兰从彤留下的照片中，得知她的男朋友是思的保镖Alan。

programme.desc: 权被派往美国工作，青拒绝跟随，夫妻形同分居，令山和如更珍惜现在关系。兰刑满出狱，为斩断与山的情丝，宁和曾同监的彤和其兄豪一起居住。兰找工作处处碰壁，幸得影视红星田思思赏识，聘为私人助理，兰更在彤的餐厅兼职。君和飞感情猛进，飞为忘记芊，决将芊的房屋出售，君以为飞真的巳放开心结。警方发现一女尸，飞认为可能是芊，整个人显得失魂落魄。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #38 [粤]
programme.desc: 警方证实女尸是美容师曼，但君已决意和飞分手。明星华宝晶在家中被杀，兰无意中听到凶手声音，成为唯一认得凶手的证人。兰勇敢地重返昔日工作的警署做证人，令山非常佩服。思待兰像朋友一般，令兰工作愉快。警方发觉晶和思同属一经理人Philip，案发当日他们亦一起工作。彤结识了新男友，并答应在豪生日当晚带他回家，可是彤却失了踪影。彤的尸体被发现弃于海边，验尸报告发现她体内留有鸡糠。兰从彤留下的照片中，得知她的男朋友是思的保镖Alan。

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #15 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #19 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #246 [粤]
programme.desc: 牛太与顺嫂买海鲜弄大餐，饭后牛太将垃圾扔在懋叔后巷。垃圾佬来收垃圾，顺嫂经过被垃圾佬指责。威哥与垃圾佬起争执，垃圾佬辞职，威哥负责处理垃圾。陈积著斌仔将垃圾丢后巷，威哥以为是牛生所为，幸最后真相大白。

programme.title: Tin Can Games
programme.desc: It's the Tin Can Games and Evil Pea wants to win the Tin Can Trophy. She cheats in the final race by putting a magnet on Supertato's back to stop him from going super fast.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. programme.title: Love in a Fallen City

programme.title: Tunnel Of Terror / Creature From The Croods Lagoon
programme.desc: Eep, Thunk, Lerk, and Womp set out to make it to the end of "The Tunnel of Terror" within the Cave of Secrets; After being rescued by a mysterious creature at the watering hole, Thunk tries to convince the Valley that a "sea thing" exists and it's not just his imagination

programme.title: Voice Fail Part 1 & 2
programme.desc: When Grug wakes up without a voice, he and Ugga go on the hunt to find his voice, while Eep, Thunk, and Gran stay behind. But when the Valleyites come to Eep with questions for Grug, she takes this opportunity to be a leader by pretending to have a conversation with Grug in their cave

programme.title: The Business Boss: Back in Baby
programme.desc: After the events of the Boss Baby 2 film, adult businessman Theodore Templeton is framed for embezzling from his company and forced to revert back to his old Boss Baby self and crash with his brother Tim. But to pull this off, he'll need to win over Tim's family into letting him stay, and convince Baby Corp to give him back his old job... which is currently held by his baby niece Tina.

programme.title: The Stroll
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: The Zippleback Experience
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belch's life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff

programme.title: Snow Way Out
programme.desc: Determined to create a key to the Dragon Eye, Ryker heads to Glacier Island to find the dangerous Snow Wraith being protected by the Dragon Riders

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Shadowy Syndrome of the Sinister Splotch
programme.desc: Captain Underpants becomes a wanted man in underwear when footage surfaces of a robber who looks exactly like him. George and Harold, positive it's an impostor, try to track down the perp and bring him to justice. But can the boys do this before Captain Underpants is found guilty?

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Blitzkrieg of the Bothersome Butt-erflies
programme.desc: As a prank, George and Harold use Melvin's new animal hybrid invention to create a creature that's a cross between a butt and a fly. But some of the monster butt-erflies want to eat everything in sight- including the students hiding out in the school gym!

programme.title: Moonlight Run
programme.desc: Aja and Krel hitch a ride in Stuart’s old UFO on a mission to rescue Vex from a bounty hunter outpost on the Moon. Meanwhile, Zadra receives intel about Morando from a surprising new ally.

programme.title: Dogfight Days of Summer
programme.desc: With Morando and his Armada heading for Earth, Aja and Krel clash with Vex and Zadra over how to handle the situation. Vex and Zadra want to alert human authorities, while the Royal teens seek out a more creative solution -- video games.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: The arrival of Tronos - a bounty hunter with the power to control electricity - sparks an investigation by Area 49-B that threatens to expose the Royals’ alien identities. Meanwhile, Mother watches as the Royals struggle to work together to deal with this new threat.

programme.title: The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: The Lotus
programme.desc: Po's moral lines are blurred when he and Blade have to break an untrustworthy hedgehog monk (Zhen) out of jail to get more information on what Klaus and Veruca stole from the Lotus. They learn from Zhen that there are in fact three more weapons, and Po recognizes one of them from a comic book.

programme.title: The Legend of Master Long-Tooth
programme.desc: Po and Blade must convince a deceased comic book writer's son to give them information about an unreleased comic that may point them toward the next weapon: a whip of fire. However, after the events of 103 Po is now a wanted criminal, so the Emperor's Forbidden Company arrives and captures him. Torn between saving Po and the mission she's sworn to complete, Blade flees and abandons Po.

programme.title: The Gateway to The Desert
programme.desc: A mysterious figure helps Po escape the guards, so Po makes his way to a desert market, determined to prove Blade wrong for leaving him behind. But when he accidentally stumbles into Klaus and Veruca, he and Blade awkwardly reunite while giving chase, and work through their differences. But the mysterious figure has followed Po and tries to capture them, clearly a new threat to our team.

programme.title: Palomino Bluffs Riding Academy
programme.desc: On their first day at Palomino Bluffs, the girls are determined to make a good impression. Cue the beachfront race - and a daring rescue!

programme.title: The Neighs Have It
programme.desc: The PALs run into their old rivals the BUDs on the first day of classes, prompting Lucky to run for class rep. Elsewhere, Abigail helps solve a mystery.

programme.title: A Rider's Balance
programme.desc: After meeting her riding idols, Pru vows to practice until she's perfect - even if it means missing out on a bonfire her best friends are planning.

programme.title: Chalk The Line / Weighting Is The Hardest Part
programme.desc: Eep cheats her way into being considered an adult; Grug learns he's no longer the strongest caveman and turns to a radical method for building brawn

programme.title: Wrestlebabia: The Musica / Flowers For Munk
programme.desc: When Sandy can't join animal wrestling she poses as "Mandy Monkhuahua"; In order to help Munk, Grug sticks super worms up his nose that make him smarter

programme.title: They Might Be Sky Giants / The Grugest Story Ever Told
programme.desc: After getting hit on the head, Eep has a vision and sets out to get the Valley to show how thankful they are; Grug feels like he's the biggest joke in Ahhh Valley, so he asks Thunk to make a "buy-o-pic" of him to show people just how truly great he is

programme.title: Night Of The Hunters Pt 1
programme.desc: When Stormfly is captured by a new enemy, Ryker Grimborn, and the Dragon Hunters, Hiccup, Toothless and the team must rescue her before it's too late

programme.title: Night Of The Hunters Pt 2
programme.desc: As Hiccup and Snotlout race to rescue the others from Ryker and the Dragon Hunters, they don't realize Dagur and Heather are working with the enemy

programme.title: Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: After a strange creature bites Tuffnut, he believes he'll turn into a legendary Lycanwing dragon when the moon is full unless his friends can save him

programme.title: Arcadia's Most Wanted
programme.desc: To stop the crime wave that has been hitting Arcadia, the Trollhunters must search for a missing Troll.

programme.title: Bad Coffee
programme.desc: When Strickler tempts Jim to use dark magic in his training, it hits the school faculty in an unexpected way!

programme.title: So I'm Dating A Sorceress
programme.desc: Jim and his friends decide to take a night off for a double date, only to discover an uninvited fifth wheel.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Ludicrous Lunacy of the Loopy Laserlightmare
programme.desc: Despite being terrible at the job, Krupp wants to be the camp director again next summer. That's something Harold and George simply cannot abide.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Shocking Showdown of the Staggering Sugamechangere
programme.desc: It's parents' weekend at Lake Summer Camp, and Krupp's eager to make amends with Harold and George ... or so he says.

programme.title: Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: The Depths
programme.desc: Lance and Hunk crash on a water planet and must rescue a mind-controlled mermaid civilization

programme.title: Shiro's Escape
programme.desc: The team sets off to a new planet where they hope to find information on Shiro's past

programme.title: Lucky And The Impatient Patient
programme.desc: While Spirit recovers from his injuries, Lucky helps out at the soda shop.

programme.title: Why Monkeys Swing In The Trees
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Monkey used to play on the ground and he loved to wind up Crocodile. One day the Big Rains came and Monkey got stranded up the Mango Tree. Nasty Crocodile promised to take him to dry land…. But only in exchange for one thing…. His HEART! Monkey tricked Crocodile and when Crocodile found out that Monkey swapped his heart for a measley mango, he chased Monkey up a tree.

programme.title: Why Tickbird Sits On Hippos Back
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Tickbird didn't sit on Hippo's back, infact they weren't friends at all! Tickbird was sick of Hippo splashing all the time. One day tiny Tickbird challenges big Hippo to a contest… who can drink the most water in a single gulp! Tickbird outwits Hippo by using the tides and from that day she is allowed to sit on Hippo's back and pick off all the yummy ticks she can eat! Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Home Is Where The Hatch Is
programme.desc: Breeze and Roary swap places for the day (and night). Roary soon discovers the beach is no place for a racing car to live, while Breeze misses the freedom of the beach.

programme.title: Putting On A Show
programme.desc: The cars are all gleaming for this evening's race. Roary gets bored and heads out onto the track - with disastrous consequences. Will the cars be ready in time for the big show?

programme.title: Motor Mouth
programme.desc: The track inspector is coming to visit and Big Chris is too tired to commentate on the race. A celebrity commentator is brought in to save the day - much to Big Chris' anger.

programme.title: Dancing Queen
programme.desc: Christine is due to take part in a dancing competition and is practising at Silver Hatch. But what happens when her dance partner is taken ill?

programme.title: Homesick Tin Top
programme.desc: Tin Top just can't master corners no matter how hard he tries. The other cars try to help him to no avail… until Roary hits on a brilliant plan.

programme.title: Save Our Tree
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is planning on cutting down Flash's tree. What can be done to save the poor rabbit's home?

programme.title: Playground / Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s "fun-crastinating" puts the project in jeopardy. / Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Iced Out
programme.desc: Frustrated that she's not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

programme.title: Monkey Planet
programme.desc: King Julien declares that lemurs will land on the moon and seeks help from a former astronaut: Stanislav, the Russian Space Monkey.

programme.title: True Bromance
programme.desc: When King Julien discovers that Maurice is moonlighting as adviser to another king, the two best friends break up.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: The Bedouin Shield
programme.desc: It’s revealed that Cleve is building a massive weather machine that is generating dangerous desert storms, with the help of a genius North African teen named Ziri. When Cleve creates a sandstorm to take out the crew, they’re saved by two Bedouin brothers named Kareem and Salem (and their pack of camels). Echo questions her ability to be a good leader and if they should give up.

programme.title: The Eye of the Sahara
programme.desc: The kids manage to make it through the crazy storm and build gliders out of parts of the fallen spy plane to travel closer to Cleve’s base and save Nowhere and Gary. Cleve sees the kids on his satellite feeds and sends a bunch of drones to take them out. During the aerial battle, Cisco splits off and leads the drones away so that the rest of the crew can escape, causing him to be lost alone in the giant storm

programme.title: Mom for a Day / Kitty in the City
programme.desc: When Mom is sick on a busy day at home, Tag offers to pick up the slack and take on her tasks for the day. Tag handles it at first, but when the responsibilities start to stack up, she realizes that being Mom is much harder than she thought. \ Tag and Scooch are excited to get to know Kit, who has organized a bunch of cat-ivities for the day. But when Kit realizes she accidentally scratched up Frank and Beans’s tree, she, Tag and Scooch find a way to make it up to them.

programme.title: The Itch To Switch / Mismatched Socks
programme.desc: When Tag is frustrated living in a crowded house, and Scooch is bored in a quiet house, the two friends switch houses for the day. At first they both love their new lives. But as Scooch gets overwhelmed by all the activity at The Barker house, and Tag gets bored by the quiet life at the Pooch’s, they eagerly switch back before the day is done. \ When the Pawston Get Sox go on a losing streak, Tag and Scooch come up with the idea to have a team mascot.

programme.title: The Fly-A-Long / Unburied Treasure
programme.desc: When the Dews' Glitter Guide, Willow comes to check on the Dews’ progress, they feel like they’re failing to impress her, until Lola gets locked out of the apartment during a game of Hide-and-Seek and Dews work together to get her back inside. / When the Dew Drops discover a time capsule in the park, they set out to find the mystery owner.

programme.title: Tooth on the Loose / That Thing You Dew
programme.desc: When Phoebe convinces the Tooth Fairy to visit before Marcus has actually lost his tooth, the Dew Drops do everything in their power to make sure the tooth is out before she arrives! / The Dews decide to hold a concert in the park for their animal friends, but can’t find the time to practice.

programme.title: You (Don't) Snooze, You Lose / Save The Squasher
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isn't always the best approach. / When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Gopher it! / A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. / When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Punch Thunk Love / Nay Boors
programme.desc: When Eep and the others try to intervene with Thunk and Blurg's first date, they decide to run away so they can live happily ever after; Snoot and Ugga race each other to get to the Doomsday Skunkguin but are forced to put their differences aside once the weirder animals come out to hunt them down

programme.title: Caverns And Creepers / Rad Teacher
programme.desc: When Eep is kicked out of Thunk's new imaginary role-playing adventure game she decides to play her own, real version of the game; Fed up with Squawk's mean teaching style, Eep has Grug fire him and replace him with Rad, the quintessential young, cool teacher

programme.title: Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Edge Of Disaster Pt 1
programme.desc: When Ruffnut is captured by Dragon Hunters, it's up to Astrid and Tuffnut to defend Dragon's Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army Dragon's Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army

programme.title: Edge Of Disaster Pt 2
programme.desc: Unaware of the war on Dragon's Edge, Hiccup, Snotlout and Johann discover an island full of dragons that have been wounded by the Dragon Hunters

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Problematic Pandemonium of the Punishing Plungerina
programme.desc: After helping George and Harold make a comic featuring the heroine Plungerina, Erica asserts that Plungerina could be better that Captain Underpants. To prove her wrong, the boys decide to actually create the villain in the comic and then have Captain Underpants save the day. Unfortunately, Krupp - and therefore Captain Underpants - is away at a principals' convention.There's no one to save them...until a real life Plungerina saves tthe day! But who is really Plungerina?

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Bombastic Blathering of Brainy Blabulous
programme.desc: When Krupp transfers to another school, George and Harold follow, only to find a bizarro version of Jerome Horwitz Elementary, where the teachers are nice and the kids are well-behaved. But no one's having any fun! George and Harold want to right this wrong with pranks and comics. But Krupp enlists Mr. Neamer (bizarro Meaner), who then super-enlargers his brain and becomes Brainy Blabulous, in order to stop the subversion of authority.

programme.title: Ill Gotten Gains
programme.desc: When Colonel Kubritz issues a medical quarantine that locks down the high school, Aja and Krel must avoid capture with help from their friends. Meanwhile Vex, Zadra, and Stuart have a run-in with a familiar face.

programme.title: There's Something About Gwen (of Gorbon)
programme.desc: When Stuart’s larger-than-life ex-girlfriend surprises him with a visit, Aja, Steve, Vex, and Nana join them on a triple date- where issues from each of their relationships come to a head. Meanwhile, Krel, Toby, and Eli discover a new passion: Sci-Fi filmmaking.

programme.title: Asteroid Rage
programme.desc: With an asteroid hurdling toward Earth, threatening to destroy Arcadia Oaks, Aja and Krel must join forces with Area 49-B -- Colonel Kubritz and Tronos -- to stop it. These strange bedfellows might save the town, but this alliance comes at a cost.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. Our villains’ alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.title: A Thread In The Dark
programme.desc: Klaus is injured and Veruca’s mage powers are not working, stifled by her time in prison. They encounter a dangerous village and Veruca reconnects with her abilities in time to save Klaus, but the two are soon captured by Po and Blade, who are unaware of Veruca’s rekindled powers.

programme.title: Welcome Back Otter
programme.desc: Abigail puts herself at risk to reunite an orphaned otter with his family. But the school veterinarian insists the animal will be safer at the zoo.

programme.title: The Palomino Family Affair
programme.desc: Lucky and Bebe spend the weekend pretending to be besties when their fathers come for a family visit and reveal that they're old friends.

programme.title: Back To The Starting Line
programme.desc: As a new term begins, Maricela and her horse, Mystery, arrive at the academy to join Lucky, Pru and Abigail for the school year.

programme.title: Worms Of Endearment / Dr Strangegrug Or How I Learned To Stop Worrying And Love The Spear
programme.desc: Lerk and Thunk hide all the valley's worms in a cave to protect them from the hunters who want to use them as bait; Grug invents the spear and pitches it to the Valley as a tool that will change cavemanity forever!

programme.title: Tunnel Of Terror / Creature From The Croods Lagoon
programme.desc: Eep, Thunk, Lerk, and Womp set out to make it to the end of "The Tunnel of Terror" within the Cave of Secrets; After being rescued by a mysterious creature at the watering hole, Thunk tries to convince the Valley that a "sea thing" exists and it's not just his imagination

programme.title: Voice Fail Part 1 & 2
programme.desc: When Grug wakes up without a voice, he and Ugga go on the hunt to find his voice, while Eep, Thunk, and Gran stay behind. But when the Valleyites come to Eep with questions for Grug, she takes this opportunity to be a leader by pretending to have a conversation with Grug in their cave

programme.title: Snoutlout Gets The Axe
programme.desc: When Snotlout and Astrid must fly a ceremonial battle axe to a family wedding, they must work together when an Armorwing dragon derails their plan

programme.title: The Zippleback Experience
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belch's life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff

programme.title: Snow Way Out
programme.desc: Determined to create a key to the Dragon Eye, Ryker heads to Glacier Island to find the dangerous Snow Wraith being protected by the Dragon Riders

programme.title: She Who Walks In The Shadows
programme.desc: When Jim discovers Claire’s sickness is much different than an average cold, they must traverse into the dangerous Shadow Realm to save her life.

programme.title: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: The Trollhunters are paused from action when their parents stage an intervention to get answers from the kids.

WCCB Tim Tszyu vs. Sebastian Fundora
programme.desc: From the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, undefeated Super Welterweight World Champion Tim Tszyu travels from Australia to defend his title against former World Champion Sebastian Fundora. Fundora stands 6'5", and is known for his all-action and exciting style. He replaces an injured Keith Thurman, and jumps into a World Title match-up against one of boxing's rising stars in Tszyu.

programme.title: In Marseille, France
programme.desc: Episode 5: Marseille, France - Hosts Jimmy Smith and Doug Anderson learn the Fight Discipline of Savate and the Martial Art of Hands and Feet with Masters Christian Robert, Frank May, Frederic Baret, Laurent Bois and Patrick Gellat.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Shane Mosley vs. Sergio Mora
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is "Sugar" Shane Mosley facing off with Sergio Mora with a highly disputed and controversial decision you will have to see to believe! The two never had a rematch. Also on the card, action from WBC Super Welterweight champ Jermell Charlo.

programme.title: Nagoya, Japan: Show 1
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Show 1 featuring Kakuryu, Ichinojo, Daieisho and Koteoko from the Nagoya basho.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights Canelo Alvarez vs. Carlos Baldomir
programme.desc: This episode features then-WBC silver light middleweight champion Saul (Canelo) Alvarez looking to give Carlos Baldomir his first career KO loss, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!

programme.title: Urijah Faber, Clay Guida, Arianny Celeste and more!
programme.desc: This episode features ring girl Arianny Celeste making a high schooler's dreams come true when she goes as his date to his prom. Also, we catch up with Clay Guida and Urijah Faber at the LA Fit Expo and we go behind the scenes for an intimate photo shoot with beautiful ring girl Amber Nicole.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA Darren Daniel vs. Dricus Du Plessis
programme.desc: Check out exciting action from MMA organizations around the world. This episode features coverage of mixed martial arts in South Africa including two Middleweights Darren "Double D" Daniel and Dricus "Stillknocks" Du Plessis who will meet in the hex for middleweight supremacy. Bonus coverage includes Alain Ilunga vs. Sydney Mokgolo and Themba Gorimbo vs. Alex Cheboub.

programme.title: MEGA Fights Paul Williams vs. Kermit Cintron
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. programme.title: 流行都市[粤]
programme.desc: 血压测量到甚么数字代表血压高？心脏科医生还提到，状况有可能导致严重并发症！患者一般都要长期服药，而降血压药分为五大类，需注意相关副作用。医生亦提供有助预防高血压的生活习惯建议。据指逾半数男性长者都有前列腺肥大问题，也担忧会引致患癌，有甚么相关检查？前列腺肥大会压住尿道致小便困难，如服药疗效欠理想，又有何新型手术可助病人解困？「睇𩠌食饭」，李家铤师傅参考日式天妇罗的做法，炮制一道「金沙酒香杏鲍菇」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在汕头[粤]
programme.desc: 汕头之旅新一集，祖蓝不止坐低等食，还提出要跟两位顶流潮菜大师学艺，尝试烹调几道经典潮菜。大师给他的首要任务是买食材，「过海」、「带靴」究竟是甚么？展示「豆酱煮膏蟹」做法，不用刀徒手就可剥开蟹盖，不愧为大师！还有「卤水乳鸽」、「鲜虾酿吊瓜」，祖蓝统统都学会了！入夜，祖蓝走进火锅店一试卤水火锅，配鹅材同吃，够浓味。不过，祖蓝更推介店内的老菜脯粥底火锅，也可配以鲜美的海鲜；但为何粥底内不见米饭？

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#18[粤]
programme.desc: 兆明日以继夜照顾昏迷的司徒岚，秀琼看在眼内深受感动。晓盈买钻石表奖励自己坐上CEO位置，威龙提醒她无须爬到山顶。威龙带丽娟探望秀琼，秀琼坦言要照顾女儿，同时不忘守护鼎福和。秀琼看到兆明颓废，晓以大义鼓励他振作。百喜升召开记招交代鼎福和未来发展，窦彰指收购的事仍未下定案。晓盈不满威龙站在窦彰一方，威龙坦言在帮她。司徒岚苏醒，却完全失去对兆明的记忆，视他为陌路人；医生指司徒岚有可能永远失去记忆……

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT![粤/日]
programme.desc: 一织厘清陆的特质后，明白到是其哀求人的表情产生的效果，于是决心要令陆感到幸福满足。大和等人上门探望TRIGGER，龙之介劝壮五与家人和好，环却表现激动，更要出手打人，天见状叫他一起出去买食物。

programme.title: Hands Up[粤]
programme.desc: 人口普查收集人口数据，原来香港有团体推行「麻雀普查」？「Kids’ Notes」请来团体代表述说相关普查细节。在港可见的麻雀主要有三种，包括树麻雀、家麻雀、山麻雀，各有甚么特色？嘉宾还谈及麻雀如何用干沙「洗澡」。另外，香港不时有野鸽聚集，但原来大多都不是本地原生，而是外来物种？珠颈斑鸠则是香港原生雀鸟，颈上的斑点就是其特征！常说「麻鹰捉鸡仔」，麻鹰也会在天空盘旋寻找食物，但牠们的主要食粮并非鸡仔？

programme.title: 天才高球少女[粤/日]
programme.desc: 五十岚误信蜻蛉戏言，吃下山羊粪，成为岛民笑柄。蜻蛉用高尔夫球杆打棒球，更把切刺身的方法应用到高球上，其控球技术再度令五十岚惊讶。五十岚发现蜻蛉缺乏斗心，但他却想让对方参加比赛。

programme.title: 财经新闻[粤]

programme.desc: 油麻地有新盘交楼，窗边防水胶条没装妥，地板也有罅隙及拱起，为何如此？

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2776[粤]
programme.desc: Elaine偶然发现Venus向壮表白，壮则称需要时间考虑再作答复。Elaine与若水商议此事，被Ceci听到，她建议Elaine写情书表白。壮收到情书，终知悉Elaine的心意，满心欢喜；原本一切顺利，她却因遗忘某事情而功亏一篑。Ceci再向她献计，打算让壮英雄救美，以制造表白机会。壮接到Elaine的讯息，得悉她有危险，竟未现身相救，也无回复。Elaine怀疑壮正往见Venus，欲给她答复……

programme.title: 康业信贷快递物业贷款呈献：正义女神#3[粤][PG]
programme.desc: 邵文处理一宗家暴案，勾起自身回忆；童年的邵文与姊姊邵玲饱受母亲毒打，邵玲为保护弟弟大义灭亲。邵玲这次希望邵文的判决可令案中施暴父亲付出代价，但事情其后出现变数……邵玲对邵文的判决感到不解，姊弟关系降至冰点。离岛三少年在山头活埋同学，此案由惠知接手审理。淑桦为其中一名被告辩护，提出三人只是受岛上恶霸谈卓飞唆摆作恶，犯案主谋应是卓飞。惠知、淑桦再次交锋，二人都想起因丽慈母子而起的往事……

programme.desc: 玉澜叫楚楚不要浪费时间，楚楚那边的人到不了，但是他们的奇兵要到了。瑾璃带人过来，路上遇到毒虫，幸好楚楚早就研制出能驱散毒虫的药粉。祐辰安三人跑进庙里，楚楚等人驱散毒虫后再进去时，他们已经从地道跑了。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈献：轰炸味蕾的厨房[粤]
programme.desc: 「90后女厨师」郑紫欣擅长煮西餐，看过西安人制作当地的特色油泼面后灵感迸发，加入西式食材，做出「西班牙辣肉肠蒜虾肉燥面」。紫欣显技即席拉面条，还应要求边拉面边转身，犹如某餐厅的师傅亲临表演，功架十足。跷脚牛肉是四川乐山市在地美食，启发家铤师傅带来「沸藤清汤牛腩」。粤菜中用萝卜、香料等焖煮的清汤腩，食用前淋上加热的花椒油，能提升香气层次。烹调过程中，祖仪这厨坛新手又发出甚么妙语，让师傅无言以对？

programme.title: 娱乐头条[粤] 及 环球新闻档案[粤]
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻[粤]

programme.desc: 少龙偷入魏营救秦兵，暴露了身分，幸得龙阳君相救。此时信陵君率众来搜，还取出魏王的御赐金牌……廷芳与善柔在渡头救起漂浮江中的人，认出是少龙。廷芳自称凤菲，不肯跟少龙相认。不韦取笑嬴政将多出一个便宜弟郎，嬴政怒气冲冲到大郑宫，太医指出朱姬有了身孕。嬴政要嫪毐护送不韦往巡视长城，伺机杀他。嬴政强行灌朱姬饮堕胎汤药时，赵高突然来报指嫪毐事败，嬴政为怕触怒不韦，任由他处置嫪毐。嫪毐强忍剧痛，吃力爬上高楼。

programme.title: 流行都市[粤]
programme.desc: 血压测量到甚么数字代表血压高？心脏科医生还提到，状况有可能导致严重并发症！患者一般都要长期服药，而降血压药分为五大类，需注意相关副作用。医生亦提供有助预防高血压的生活习惯建议。据指逾半数男性长者都有前列腺肥大问题，也担忧会引致患癌，有甚么相关检查？前列腺肥大会压住尿道致小便困难，如服药疗效欠理想，又有何新型手术可助病人解困？「睇𩠌食饭」，李家铤师傅参考日式天妇罗的做法，炮制一道「金沙酒香杏鲍菇」。

programme.desc: 汕头之旅新一集，祖蓝不止坐低等食，还提出要跟两位顶流潮菜大师学艺，尝试烹调几道经典潮菜。大师给他的首要任务是买食材，「过海」、「带靴」究竟是甚么？展示「豆酱煮膏蟹」做法，不用刀徒手就可剥开蟹盖，不愧为大师！还有「卤水乳鸽」、「鲜虾酿吊瓜」，祖蓝统统都学会了！入夜，祖蓝走进火锅店一试卤水火锅，配鹅材同吃，够浓味。不过，祖蓝更推介店内的老菜脯粥底火锅，也可配以鲜美的海鲜；但为何粥底内不见米饭？
